6899.description_text: Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Grass-Fed Milk Protein Isolate 30 g Our grass-fed milk protein isolate is sourced from cows that graze on lush pastures, ensuring a premium quality protein that retains the natural balance of casein and whey. This, in turn, provides a superior nutritional profile and complete profile of amino acids for optimal muscle growth and recovery. Grass-Fed Milk Protein Isolate × Close 30 g Grass-fed milk is characterized by a distinct fatty acid profile that is beneficial for human health. Studies have shown that milk from cows that graze on fresh grass has higher concentrations of beneficial fatty acids, including omega-3 fatty acids and conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) (1, 2, 3). The increased levels of these fatty acids are attributed to the high content of alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) found in forage grasses, which enhances the overall fatty acid composition of the milk (2). This enhanced fatty acid profile is not only a result of the cows' diet but also reflects the metabolic processes that occur when cows consume fresh forage, which is significantly different from grain-based diets.The nutritional benefits of grass-fed milk extend beyond fatty acids. Studies have shown that grass-fed milk contains higher levels of certain vitamins and antioxidants, such as vitamin E and beta-carotene, which are essential for human health. These nutrients are derived from the diverse plant species that cows consume while grazing, contributing to a richer nutrient profile in the milk. Additionally, the antioxidant activity in grass-fed milk has been linked to the presence of phytochemicals that are more abundant in pasture-based diets (3). / Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. 6900.description_text: Product Overview Transparent Labs Vitality is an innovative 3-in-1 natural hormone optimizing supplement that boosts bioactive testosterone levels while controlling estrogen and cortisol production. Set the foundation for lean muscle gains, fat burning, strength, libido, confidence, and overall vitality with clinical doses of proven ingredients, such as LJ100® Eurycoma longifolia extract, KSM-66® organic ashwagandha extract, PrimaVie® shilajit extract, L-OptiZinc®, and BioPerine®. These premium ingredients work synergistically to protect Leydig cells that comprise the testicles, reduce aromatase activity, and augment luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) which govern testosterone production and fertility. In turn, TL Vitality primes the body for optimal well-being and athletic performance by encouraging balanced ratios of testosterone to cortisol and testosterone to estradiol. Ingredient Profile Directions: As a Dietary Supplement, Take 2 Capsules Once Daily.Serving Size: 2 CapsulesServings Per Container: 30 Zinc (as L-OptiZinc® (L-Methionine)) - 15 mg L-OptiZinc® is a special chelated zinc that’s formed with L-methionine. Research shows that zinc-methionine complex is one of the most bioavailable forms of zinc, ensuring your body properly absorbs and utilizes this key mineral.1Zinc has diverse actions in the human body since it is a cofactor for various metalloenzymes. Human studies suggest that zinc is especially crucial for supporting fertility and testosterone production in adult males.2,3 One study found that middle-aged men with preexisting infertility experienced an average 250% increase in sperm cell counts and 54% increase in total testosterone levels after taking a zinc supplement daily for three months.4 Also, males with zinc deficiency are generally at a greater risk of infertility.5 Organic Ashwagandha Extract (as KSM-66®) - 600 mg KSM-66® Ashwagandha Root Extract (standardized to contain ≥5% withanolides): Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is arguably the most versatile adaptogenic herb known to man. A thorough body of clinical research has shown that ashwagandha consumption promotes healthy testosterone levels and mitigates stress-induced cortisol secretion, thereby encouraging better quality of life in men.6 Notably, a formative 3-month study of 75 adult males given 600 mg of ashwagandha root extract daily found that testosterone levels increased an average of 40% above baseline values.7 Their sperm cell count (i.e. fertility) also improved significantly. Shilajit Extract (as PrimaVie®) - 250mg Shilajit is a rare exudate (thick fluid) found naturally in rocks of the Himalayan mountains; it’s formed over the course of centuries by microorganisms that decompose plant material. Shilajit is commonly used in Ayurveda as a means of improving vitality and overall well-being. Several controlled human studies have shown that shilajit can significantly increase total testosterone and free testosterone levels, the latter of which is the “biologically useful” form of testosterone.8 One recent clinical trial even found that healthy adult males given a purified shilajit supplement for 90 days experienced nearly 50% greater increases in free testosterone levels than those who were in the placebo group9. Quercetin Dihydrate - 250 mg Quercetin is a secondary plant metabolite (polyphenol) found in a range of fruits and vegetables. It’s a vital micronutrient that serves antioxidant roles in many important body systems, particularly the cardiovascular system and reproductive system.10 Several murine studies suggest that quercetin protects Leydig cells — the cells that comprise testicular tissue — from toxin-induced damage, thereby preserving testosterone levels and fertility11,12. DIM (Diindolylmethane) - 125 mg 3,3′-diindolylmethane (DIM) is a bioactive metabolite of indole-3-carbinol (I3C), a phytochemical found in cruciferous vegetables like cabbage, broccoli, and cauliflower. DIM appears to regulate estrogen metabolism by selectively modulating the aryl-hydrocarbon receptor, which plays an important role in gene expression in both men and women.13 In vivo and in vitro data suggest that DIM has favorable effects on muscle growth, recovery, libido, mood, and overall well-being by balancing estradiol levels14,15 LJ100® (Standardized Eurycoma longifolia extract) - 100mg Eurycoma longifolia, commonly referred to as Tongkat ali or Longjack, has been used for centuries in folk medicine as a natural aphrodisiac and appetite-stimulating herb. The roots of this plant contain a range of compounds called quassinoids, the most noteworthy being eurycomanone. Several studies have shown that athletes supplementing Eurycoma longifolia have significant increases in the ratio of testosterone to cortisol, as well as improvements in lean body mass, strength, and arm circumference.16,17,18 Vitality is formulated with premium LJ100® that delivers a standardized amount of bioactive quassinoids. Bioperine® (Black Pepper (Fruit) Extract) - 10 mg Bioperine® is an extract obtained from the black pepper fruit. In its patented form, BioPerine® has been clinically tested (in the United States) to significantly enhance the bioavailability of various supplement nutrients through increased absorption. Boron (as Bororganic Glycine) - 5 mg Boron is an essential trace mineral that plays numerous roles throughout the body. A recent research review suggests that men who supplement with boron daily have significantly higher levels of testosterone and lower levels of estradiol (estrogen) than those who don’t take a boron supplement.19 Even more compelling, supplemental boron has been shown to boost free testosterone and reduce estrogen within just one week.20 Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. 6902.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine is the all-natural solution for active individuals and athletes looking to accelerate muscle recovery, reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS), and support hydration. Each serving of this deliciously refreshing formula provides 8,000 mg of fermented, vegan-friendly branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) in the evidence-based 2:1:1 ratio, plus 5,000 mg of L-glutamine, 1,500 mg of vitamin C, and 1,000 mg of coconut water powder. Unlike many BCAA supplements, our BCAA powder doesn't contain animal-derived amino acids, added sugars, artificial sweeteners (e.g., acesulfame potassium and sucralose), artificial food dyes, or unnecessary additives. Key Features Clinically Dosed BCAA Powder: Each serving of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine includes 8,000 mg of vegan branched-chain amino acids in a 2:1:1 ratio to enhance muscle recovery, reduce muscle soreness, and bolster muscle protein synthesis. Synergistic Formula for Pre-/Intra-/Post-Workout Use: In addition to branched-chain amino acids, our BCAA powder provides 5,000 mg of L-glutamine, 1,500 mg of vitamin C, and 1,000 mg of coconut water powder to promote hydration, support immune function, and decrease muscle damage. Vegan-Friendly, Gluten-Free, and Non-GMO: Many BCAA supplements contain low-grade amino acids derived from human hair; we formulated an original BCAA powder with fermented, vegan-friendly BCAAs made from microbial cultures. This product is also non-GMO and gluten-free to accommodate your healthy lifestyle. Pure, Quality Ingredients (No Fillers or Nonsense): Consistent with our core values, Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine is third-party tested for purity, potency, and authenticity. Our BCAA powder is naturally flavored and sweetened with stevia to accommodate your healthy lifestyle; no artificial additives or sugar. Delicious and Natural Fruit Flavors: Choose from four tasty flavors - Strawberry Lemonade, Blue Raspberry, Sour Green Apple, and Tropical Punch. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. How to Use Instructions Combine one (1) level scoop of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine with 10-12 ounces of cold water or your preferred beverage and mix until powder is fully dissolved. Consume 30-45 minutes before, during, or immediately after your workout. An additional one to two scoops may be taken throughout the day. Do not exceed three (3) servings per day. Optimal Consumption Times Pre-Workout: Consuming our BCAA powder before your workout helps prime your body for exercise with key amino acids and micronutrients. Intra-Workout: Sipping on a serving of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine during your workout can prevent a decline in performance by mitigating muscle fatigue and sustaining hydration. This is especially beneficial if you tend to sweat a lot or exercise in hot/humid conditions. Post-Workout: Ingesting Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine post-workout aids in recovery by supporting protein synthesis, reducing soreness, and rehydrating the body. Active Ingredients and Benefits Fermented Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs) 2:1:1 | 8,000 mg Branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) are a group of three essential amino acids—L-leucine, L-isoleucine, and L-valine—that play an integral role in muscle protein synthesis, the process by which cells create new muscle proteins (which is necessary for muscle recovery and hypertrophy). While there are nine essential amino acids, L-leucine is widely regarded as the “master regulator” of protein synthesis [1]. Research suggests that supplementing with a 2:1:1 ratio of BCAAs (leucine: isoleucine:valine) post-workout can mitigate the severity of delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) and decrease muscle damage markers, such as creatine kinase [2]. Further evidence indicates that BCAA supplementation improves endurance and muscle strength by reducing rates of perceived exertion and increasing lactate thresholds during exercise [3, 4]. Additionally, BCAAs can help protect against muscle protein breakdown during weight-loss phases [5, 6]. Glutamine | 5,000 mg L-glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in human muscle and plasma; however, it is a conditionally essential amino acid for active gym-goers and athletes since intense and long-duration exercise can deplete glutamine stores in the body [7]. Studies show that glutamine supplementation helps improve muscle glycogen synthesis, gut health, and immune function in active individuals, making it useful for muscle recovery and performance [8, 9, 10]. Clinical research has shown that glutamine also plays a key role in protein synthesis despite being a non-essential amino acid [11]. Vitamin C | 1,500 mg Vitamin C is a ubiquitous antioxidant vitamin that, when taken in large doses (>1 gram per day), can reduce muscle soreness and bolster recovery between workouts [12]. It also plays a vital role in collagen synthesis and throughout the immune system, with evidence that it may reduce the severity and duration of upper respiratory tract infections [13]. Coconut Water Powder | 1,000 mg Coconut water is one of the best natural sources of electrolytes and trace minerals, making it a perfect ingredient for replenishing and rehydrating during and after training. Coconut (Cocos nucifera) has been shown to provide a wealth of general health benefits, including, but not limited to [14]: Rehydrating the body Fighting inflammation Balancing blood glucose and insulin levels Promoting immune function Enhancing eye and skin health Supporting kidney function FAQs Section What Does BCAA Powder Do? L-Citrulline Malate (2:1) 8,000 mg L-citrulline is a well-known nitric oxide booster that enhances blood flow, reduces muscle fatigue, and boosts endurance. Beta-Alanine 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is an amino acid that enhances muscular endurance, delays fatigue, and improves performance by increasing muscle carnosine levels. BetaPure™ Betaine Anhydrous 2,500 mg Betaine Anhydrous keeps muscle cells hydrated, supports energy production, and boosts muscle endurance, strength, and overall performance. Taurine 1,300 mg Taurine is an amino acid, essential to nervous system function and helps prevent fatigue during intense exercise. L-Tyrosine 1,000 mg L-tyrosine is an amino acid that serves as a precursor to dopamine and norepinephrine. AlphaSize® Alpha-GPC 300 mg Alpha-GPC supports athletic performance by increasing acetylcholine and stimulating growth hormone secretion. Vitamins B6 and B12 5 mg and 100 mcg Vitamins B6 and B12 play essential roles as coenzymes in various enzymatic processes important to energy production and neurotransmitter synthesis. Sodium and Potassium 180 mg and 125 mg Sodium and potassium are arguably the most important electrolyte minerals, being well-known to impact hydration status and exercise performance. L-Citrulline Malate (2:1) × Close 8,000 mg L-Citrulline malate is an amino acid that enhances physical endurance due to its role in the synthesis of nitric oxide (NO) . [1]When nitric oxide production increases, blood flow improves, allowing nutrients and oxygen to replenish muscle tissue more efficiently. Beta-Alanine × Close 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is an amino acid that functions as a precursor to carnosine, a molecule that accumulates in skeletal muscle tissue, where it plays a crucial role in buffering the acid produced during intense physical exercise. Supplementing with Beta-alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine levels, which are quickly depleted during intense exercise [6, 7].Research shows that supplementing with Beta-alanine can significantly improve overall exercise capacity including maximal strength and power output, particularly in exercises requiring sustained maximal effort[8]. strength [9] Beta-alanine supplementation may also increase lean muscle mass [10] and delay the onset of neuromuscular fatigue [11, 12] BetaPure™ Betaine Anhydrous × Close 2,500 mg Betaine, also known as trimethylglycine, plays a role in various physiological processes, primarily as an osmolyte (helping cells maintain fluid balance) and a methyl donor (assisting in biochemical reactions). Betaine supplementation has shown promise in improving muscle endurance and enhancing strength and power in trained individuals [13, 14, 15].While the mechanisms are not fully understood, Betaine supplementation may promote athletic performance through regulating cellular hydration, supporting creatine biosynthesis and playing a role in ATP (energy) production. [16] Taurine × Close 1,300 mg Taurine is one of the most well studied performance aids offering diverse benefits for athletes and active individuals. Evidence indicates that adequate taurine levels are pivotal for central nervous system (CNS) function and may help prevent fatigue during arduous exercise. [17]Taurine has been shown to be effective in enhancing both aerobic and anaerobic performance while also supporting recovery from exercise. [ 18, 19] Several studies have demonstrated that taurine supplementation can help delay time to exhaustion and decrease rate of perceived exertion making it an important ingredient for intense physical activity. [20, 21] L-Tyrosine × Close 1,000 mg Increasing tyrosine uptake may positively influence neurotransmitter-related psychological functioning. Research shows that supplementing with L-tyrosine can significantly enhance cognitive performance, especially under acutely stressful situations (such as intense training) [22].L-Tyrosine has also been shown to improve “cognitive flexibility,” meaning it can help you adapt to changing cognitive demands without letting extraneous thoughts take over [23]. AlphaSize® Alpha-GPC × Close 300 mg Alpha-GPC (L-alpha-glycerylphosphorylcholine) is a cholinergic compound that supports neuromuscular function and physical performance by increasing acetylcholine levels. Studies have shown that supplementation with Alpha-GPC can enhance power output and strength. 6904.description_text: Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Arabica Coffee (Caffeine) 170 mg The natural caffeine from Arabica coffee beans provides a smooth and steady boost in alertness and focus, just like drinking a cup of premium coffee. Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate 20 g Grass-fed whey protein isolate provides easily digestible, rapidly absorbed protein with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it ideal for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. Arabica Coffee (Caffeine) × Close 170 mg Arabica Coffee provides a smooth, sustained alertness alongside a robust antioxidant profile, making it ideal for supporting mental focus and physical performance. It is a highly bioavailable source of caffeine and bioactive polyphenols, and is widely recognized as a potent ergogenic aid. Research shows that caffeine improves performance by reducing perceived exertion and delaying fatigue through adenosine receptor antagonism, increasing central nervous system excitability [1, 2], as well as enhancing muscle strength and power output by facilitating calcium mobilization and neuromuscular transmission [3].Arabica coffee can help kickstart your physical and mental drive without the aggressive, jittery crash often associated with other stimulants. By providing a clean, energy source, it can help improve alertness and postpone fatigue, contributing to more focused and effective training sessions. Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate × Close 20 g The quality of protein matters, and whey protein isolate is one of the purest forms of protein available. It provides a high protein content with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it an exceptional choice for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. In contrast to whey protein concentrate, whey protein isolate undergoes further filtration to remove virtually all of the lactose, making it more suitable for those who have difficulty digesting lactose.Whey protein isolate is known for its rapid absorption and ideal ratio of all nine essential amino acids (EAAs)—which includes the branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs)—necessary for stimulating muscle protein synthesis [4,5]. In other words, whey protein isolate is about as good as it gets for kickstarting the muscle-building process after working out. By providing essential nutrients needed for muscle repair, whey isolate can reduce recovery time, allowing for more consistent and intense training sessions.So, why does the "grass-fed" distinction matter for whey protein powder? The vast majority of whey protein powders are made from the milk of grain-fed cows, whereas grass-fed whey protein is derived from the milk of cows that graze on natural, pesticide-free grass pastures instead of feeding on grains. Grass-feeding positively impacts the nutritional composition and quality of a cow's milk and milk byproducts. [6].Research has found that grass-fed whey protein boasts higher levels of bioactive whey peptides (e.g. immunoglobulins and lactoferrin), omega-3 essential fatty acids, conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), and vitamins E and A—nutrients essential for inflammation control, muscle recovery, and overall health [7]. / Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. 6905.description_text: Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. SIRTality® NMN (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) 600 mg SIRTality® NMN is a precursor to NAD+, providing the essential biological building blocks needed to help maintain NAD+ levels throughout the aging process. SIRTality® NMN (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) × Close 600 mg NMN is a naturally occurring molecule that serves as a precursor to NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide), which is a vital coenzyme involved in cellular repair, energy production, and metabolic health. While NMN is naturally present in small amounts in everyday foods like broccoli, avocado, and cucumber, obtaining clinically effective doses through diet alone is impractical.NAD+ drives cellular vitality, but these levels naturally decline significantly as we age. This drop can influence how efficiently our cells produce energy (ATP) and how well they recover from everyday activities. When NAD+ levels fall, cellular function slows down, often leading to reduced energy and impaired metabolic function.By replenishing the body’s NMN supply, the body receives what it needs to maintain normal NAD+ levels to support healthy cellular function and metabolism during aging. / Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. 6909.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate has become a pantry staple among health-conscious consumers who want a quality source of protein for supporting muscle growth, recovery, and overall health. Unlike many protein powders on the market, TL whey protein isolate is sourced from grass-fed cattle, raised humanely and without the use of growth hormones or hormonal agents, and contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, food dyes, or fillers. Choose from 14 (and counting) delicious flavor options, or select the unflavored option if you prefer a pure whey protein isolate powder with a neutral taste. Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate is easy to mix with liquids and can be incorporated into various recipes, making it a convenient and versatile protein source that fits easily into any diet. Key Features: 28 grams of protein per serving, boasting an industry-leading protein-by-weight percentage of 87.5% (may vary slightly by flavor). Sourced exclusively from grass-fed American dairy cattle, raised without the use of growth hormone, growth factors, and/or anabolic steroids. Made with natural ingredients and no artificial sweeteners, fillers, food dyes, gluten, or preservatives. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice and Informed Protein to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Virtually lactose-free and only 1 gram of fat per serving, perfect for adding an easily digestible, quality source of protein to your diet. Trusted by the best to be the best, with an overall rating of 98 out of 100 by Labdoor and backed by athletes like Paul Sklar & Hafthor Björnsson, Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate has set a standard as the cleanest whey protein powder available. Available in 14 delicious flavors that cater to every palate while supporting lean muscle growth and overall protein intake. Active Ingredients and Benefits Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate The quality of your protein matters, and whey protein isolate is one of the purest forms of protein available. It provides a high protein content with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it an exceptional choice for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. In contrast to whey protein concentrate, whey protein isolate undergoes further filtration to remove virtually all of the lactose, making it more suitable for those who have difficulty digesting lactose. Whey protein isolate is known for its rapid absorption and ideal ratio of all nine essential amino acids (EAAs)—which includes the branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs)—necessary for stimulating muscle protein synthesis [1, 2]. In other words, whey protein isolate is about as good as it gets for kickstarting the muscle-building process after working out. By providing essential nutrients needed for muscle repair, whey protein isolate can reduce recovery time, allowing for more consistent and intense training sessions. So, why does the "grass-fed" distinction matter for whey protein powder? The vast majority of whey protein powders are made from the milk of grain-fed cows, whereas grass-fed whey protein is derived from the milk of cows that graze on natural, pesticide-free grass pastures instead of feeding on grains. Grass-feeding positively impacts the nutritional composition and quality of a cow's milk (which is subsequently used to make cheese, and "whey" is a byproduct of cheesemaking) [3]. Research has found that grass-fed whey protein boasts higher levels of bioactive whey peptides (e.g. immunoglobulins and lactoferrin), omega-3 essential fatty acids, conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), and vitamins E and A—nutrients essential for inflammation control, muscle recovery, and overall health [4]. Just as important, grass-fed whey protein isolate is free from added hormones and antibiotics that may persist in conventional dairy products [5]. How to Use Maximize your results with Transparent Labs Whey Protein Isolate by following these guidelines: Mixing Instructions Combine one scoop (~32 g) of Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate with 6-8 ounces of water, milk, or your preferred beverage in a shaker cup (with a wire whisk ball) for a smooth, delicious protein shake. Seal the shaker cup and shake vigorously for a few seconds until the powder is fully dissolved, then enjoy! Optimal Consumption Times Post-Workout Recovery: Whey protein isolate is quickly absorbed by the body, making it ideal for post-workout recovery as it helps to repair and build muscle tissue efficiently. Anytime Protein Boost: Our grass-fed whey protein isolate can also be used in recipes (e.g., pancakes) and incorporated into foods like yogurt and oatmeal to easily increase daily protein intake. FAQs How Does Whey Protein Isolate Differ from Whey Protein Concentrate? Whey Protein Isolate undergoes additional processing to remove most of the lactose and fat content, leaving >90% protein. Whey protein isolate is often preferred over whey protein concentrate due to its higher protein purity and reduced allergen content. Is Whey Protein Good for Weight Loss or just Muscle Building? Protein is known for its satiating and thermodynamic effects, which can help reduce hunger and increase calorie expenditure. Incorporating whey protein isolate into your diet can assist in weight management by promoting fullness and an energy deficit. What’s in your “Natural Flavors”? The natural flavors used in our products are derived from natural sources such as plants, fruits, or spices to enhance the taste of our products. 6910.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Hydrate is a sugar-free electrolyte powder featuring bioavailable minerals, taurine, SenActiv®, and coconut water powder to help you stay hydrated throughout the day and during training. Unlike conventional “sports drinks” and many electrolyte powders, Transparent Labs Hydrate contains no added sugars, artificial coloring, or artificial sweeteners. Instead, this electrolyte supplement is made with natural flavoring and sweetened with stevia to deliver a refreshing, sugar-free hydration boost to your daily water intake. Key Features: Pure Electrolytes for Optimal Hydration: Formulated with a bioavailable electrolyte mixture to promote optimal hydration, including TRAACS® calcium bisglycinate, Aquamin™ magnesium, sodium from Himalayan rock salt, taurine, and natural potassium from organic coconut water powder. Enhanced with Senactiv™: Patented adaptogen complex that supports exercise performance and muscle recovery at the subcellular level. Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, and Naturally Sweetened with Stevia: Sweetened naturally with stevia leaf extract; no added sugar or hidden carbohydrates like other electrolyte supplements. Powdered Drink Mix in Six Refreshing Flavors: Choose from Raspberry Lemonade, Peach Mango, Blue Raspberry, Arctic Freeze, Tropical Punch, and Lemon Lime. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits Senactiv™ | 50 mg: SenActiv® is a patented, clinically studied ergogenic adaptogen complex that provides highly purified and fractionated extracts of Panax notoginseng and Rosa roxburghii (rose hips). The unique phytochemicals in SenActiv® have been shown to enhance subcellular processes that accelerate muscle recovery after exhaustive exercise [1]. These compounds also possess adaptogenic properties to facilitate athletic performance and healthy aging [2]. Taurine | 1,000 mg: Taurine is a naturally occurring sulfonic acid not abundant in the diet. Supplementing with taurine provides cell-hydrating properties and neuroprotective effects throughout the nervous system [3]. In addition, a recent meta-analysis concluded that taurine can significantly enhance stamina, strength, and power capacity during exercise, and it appears to have a range of cognitive benefits as well [4]. Calcium (as TRAACS® Calcium Bisglycinate and Di-Calcium Phosphate) | 84 mg: Calcium is an essential mineral for enhancing the integrity of bone and promoting the growth, proliferation, and differentiation of bone cells [5]. It’s also a crucial micronutrient in muscles as it associates with mitochondria in muscle cells to stimulate ATP synthesis [6]. To ensure optimal efficacy and absorption, TL Hydrate features TRAACS chelated calcium and dicalcium phosphate, two highly bioavailable forms of supplemental calcium [7]. Magnesium (as Aquamin™ Mg) | 50 mg: Extracted from red algae, Aquamin™ is a natural source of magnesium and 72 other trace minerals. Magnesium is a vital electrolyte mineral that has ubiquitous roles in the body, one of which is regulating muscle contraction [8]. Aquamin® Magnesium provides magnesium in its native ionic state for optimal biocompatibility. Magnesium deficiency is well-known to cause issues with the intestines and often contributes to constipation and dehydration [9]. As such, consuming adequate amounts of bioavailable magnesium is imperative for active individuals. Sodium (as Sodium Citrate and from Himalayan Rock Salt) | 500 mg: Sodium is the primary positive ion (cation) in the fluid outside of cells. It modulates the amount of water in the body and the movement of sodium into and out of cells is essential for proper cell-to-cell signaling. Potassium (as Potassium Citrate, Potassium Chloride, and from Organic Coconut Water) | 250 mg: As a counterpart to sodium, potassium is the primary cationic (positively charged) electrolyte inside cells. The balance of sodium and potassium is particularly important for cellular hydration, and potassium is necessary for intra- and inter-cellular signaling, as well as being a substrate for skeletal muscle contraction. Organic Coconut Water Powder | 500 mg: Coconut water powder removes the sugary and fatty constituents of coconut water while retaining the essential electrolyte micronutrients, such as magnesium, potassium, phosphorus, and sodium. Due to its abundant electrolyte profile, coconut water can rapidly rehydrate athletes after intense exercise, making it ideal for pre-, intra-, and post-workout supplementation [11]. How to Use Designed for before, during, and after your workout sessions, Transparent Labs Hydrate rapidly replenishes electrolytes and supports muscle contractility, endurance, recovery, and cell volumization. Get the most out of this electrolyte powder by following these guidelines: Mixing Instructions Mix one scoop of Transparent Labs Hydrate with 6-8 ounces of water. For a consistent mix, use a shaker cup or water bottle and shake until the powder is fully dissolved. If using more than one scoop at a time, adjust the amount of water accordingly; less water will result in a stronger flavor, and vice versa. Optimal Consumption Times Pre-Workout: Drinking our hydration powder before your workout helps prepare your body for physical activity, ensuring you're well-hydrated from the get-go. Intra-Workout: Sipping electrolytes during your workout is especially useful if you start feeling dehydrated and/or you're a heavy sweater. Post-Workout: Taking a serving of Transparent Labs Hydrate after your workout is also great for recovery and rehydration, helping to replenish lost fluids and electrolytes. 6916.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Bulk Black is the pinnacle of a clinically dosed pre-workout supplement for stim lovers. If you have experience with our regular Bulk Pre-Workout formula but want some extra "pep" in your step, this is the pre-workout for you. Each scoop of Bulk Black packs over 17 grams of proven nitric oxide boosters, hard-hitting nootropics, natural testosterone-supporting ingredients, and muscle fortifiers dosed according to scientific evidence, so you can bring the noise every time you walk into the gym. Like all Transparent Labs pre-workout formulas, Bulk Black contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, flavors, food dyes, or added sugars. Key Features Evidence-Based "Hardcore" Pre-Workout for Lean Muscle Gain: Like the regular Bulk Pre-Workout formula, Bulk Black features a comprehensive lineup of science-backed active ingredients to help dedicated athletes and gym-goers build muscle mass and perform at peak capacity. Experience Intense Muscle Pumps with Proven Nitric Oxide Boosters: Bulk Black Pre-Workout contains clinical doses of L-citrulline, beta-alanine, and betaine anhydrous to enhance blood flow and give you those oh-so-satisfying, intense muscle pumps during training. Stimulates Mental Sharpness, Focus, Drive, and Energy: Get into the "zone" every time you hit the gym with nootropics backed by scientific evidence, like alpha-GPC (AlphaSize®), caffeine (PurCaf®), L-tyrosine, and taurine. Bulk black pre-workout contains just the right amount of hard-hitting nootropics to deliver a psychotropic rush without the dreaded post-workout crash. Epic All-Natural Flavors Sweetened with Stevia: Many other pre-workout formulas are laden with artificial sweeteners, food dyes, and unnecessary fillers. We know you care about what you put in your body, so Bulk Black Pre-Workout contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, added sugars, or food dyes, and the formula is naturally sweetened with stevia. Choose from multiple refreshing flavor options, including Black Cherry, Cherry kiwi, Peach Mango, Blue Raspberry, Watermelon Peach, Blueberry Pomegranate, and Sour Gummy. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits *Doses listed are per serving (1 full scoop) L-Citrulline Malate (2:1) | 8,000 mg L-citrulline is an amino acid naturally found in watermelon that plays an important role in kidney function. It's become a popular ingredient in pre-workout supplements due to its ability to boost nitric oxide levels [1]. When nitric oxide production increases, blood flow improves, allowing nutrients and oxygen to replenish muscle tissue more efficiently. Ultimately, this translates to greater muscle pumps and heightened energy levels. Numerous studies have demonstrated the ergogenic effects of L-citrulline malate, the citrulline salt of malic acid, such as: Improving strength, aerobic performance, and muscle endurance [2, 3] Elevating nitric oxide levels even more than equivalent doses of L-arginine [4] Enhancing muscle anabolism and reducing muscle catabolism [5] Beta-Alanine | 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is a beta-amino acid that combines with L-histidine to form a dipeptide known as carnosine. Supplementing with beta-alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine levels, which are quickly depleted during intense exercise [6]. Carnosine is an endogenous dipeptide that functions as a buffer in muscle cells, thereby attenuating the accumulation of acidic byproducts of muscular exertion (e.g. lactate and hydrogen ions) [7]. Hence, bolstering muscle carnosine levels—via beta-alanine—allows you to push yourself longer and harder in the gym. Pre-workout supplements almost always contain beta-alanine but in inefficacious doses. We made sure to include a full clinical dose of beta-alanine (4,000 mg) in every scoop of BULK Pre-Workout. Relevant evidence-based benefits of beta-alanine include: Delaying the onset of neuromuscular fatigue during intense exercise [8] Increasing overall muscle strength [9] Improving muscle endurance and total work capacity [10] Reducing and combatting the formation of dysfunctional proteins and promoting the formation of healthy proteins [11] Significantly increasing lean muscle mass as part of a diligent resistance-training program [12] *Note that beta-alanine causes a benign tingling sensation known as paresthesia while the body acclimates to higher carnosine levels. This effect is harmless and gradually lessens with consistent use. BetaPure™ Betaine Anhydrous | 2,500 mg Betaine, also known as trimethylglycine, is a naturally occurring metabolite that serves as a methyl donor and osmolyte in the body. Though the mechanisms are not entirely understood, betaine supplementation has shown promise in enhancing power output and, to a lesser extent, endurance capacity in athletes [13, 14, 15]. It is plausible that betaine supplementation promotes athletic performance by maintaining cellular hydration and reducing homocysteine levels, thereby encouraging healthy cardiovascular function and blood flow [16]. Taurine | 1,300 mg Taurine is another staple pre-workout ingredient with diverse benefits for athletes and gym-goers. For one, taurine is a potent nootropic that confers synergy with caffeine to promote focus and reduce brain cell inflammation and oxidative stress [17, 18]. Taurine can also enhance physical performance via increased blood flow to skeletal muscle tissue [19, 20]. Greater blood flow to muscle tissue encourages a favorable milieu for muscle function and recovery during training. Additionally, taurine supplementation has been shown to improve performance in endurance athletes [21]. L-Tyrosine | 1,000

6919.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Grass-Fed Colostrum is a premium, clinically formulated bovine colostrum supplement designed to support immune function, gut health, and muscle synthesis. Support immune resilience, gut integrity, and muscle recovery with a clinically effective 20g dose of bioactive-rich, grass-fed bovine colostrum. Optimize Immune FunctionHelp balance immune responses during intense exercise, and reduce training-related inflammation. Support Gut HealthStrengthen the gut barrier and reduce intestinal permeability (leaky gut) especially in high-stress training environments. Ours delivers 20g per serving—the clinically validated dose—sourced from grass-fed cows and processed to preserve its full spectrum of bioactive compounds for performance-driven results. Is it safe to take colostrum supplements daily? For most healthy individuals, daily consumption of bovine colostrum is considered safe. However, those with dairy allergies or lactose intolerance should exercise caution. It's advisable to consult with a healthcare provider before starting any new supplement regimen. Can colostrum supplements be combined with other protein powders or powdered supplements like collagen? Yes, colostrum can be mixed with other protein supplements or collagen. Combining them may offer complementary benefits, supporting both immune function and joint or skin health. Ensure that the combination fits within your dietary needs and consult with a healthcare provider if unsure. When is the best time to take colostrum? For optimal absorption and gut-related benefits, colostrum is best taken on an empty stomach—either first thing in the morning or between meals. Avoid mixing with hot liquids, which can degrade bioactive compounds. 6920.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Growth is a versatile anabolic catalyst featuring a clinically effective dose (1,500 mg) of Mediator® phosphatidic acid in every serving. This formula amplifies muscle protein synthesis and bolsters athletic performance through dynamic intra- and inter-cellular signaling pathways that govern muscular adaptations. Since Mediator® phosphatidic acid is a stimulant-free ingredient, you can stack Growth with your favorite pre-workout and post-workout supplements for additional performance and body composition benefits. Key Features Clinically Dosed Phosphatidic Acid Supplement: Each serving of Transparent Labs Growth provides a clinically studied dose of patented Mediator® Phosphatidic Acid, a naturally occurring glycerophospholipid that plays an important role in muscle protein synthesis (and, by extension, muscle growth). Supports Lean Body Mass & Skeletal Muscle Hypertrophy: Several studies have found that phosphatidic acid supplementation significantly increases resistance-exercise-induced hypertrophy and lean muscle mass in active individuals. Amplifies Muscle Strength Gains: Supplemental phosphatidic acid is suggested to promote muscle protein synthesis through a distinct pathway that ultimately converges with mechanical stimuli, creating a more pronounced muscle hypertrophy response after lifting weights. Pure, Quality Ingredients (No Fillers or Nonsense): Consistent with our core values, each batch of Transparent Labs Growth is third-party tested for purity, potency, and authenticity. This unflavored powder contains absolutely no additives and mixes easily in water. Active Ingredients and Benefits Mediator® Phosphatidic Acid | 1,500 mg Phosphatidic acid is a naturally occurring molecule, specifically a glycerophospholipid, found in cell membranes. It acts as a lipid mediator by transmitting signals within cells that are essential for various biological processes, including muscle protein synthesis. Mediator® Phosphatidic Acid is a patented and clinically studied form of phosphatidic acid that has been shown to increase max strength, muscle mass, and fat loss in healthy adults who engage in resistance training [1]. The ergogenic benefits of phosphatidic acid supplementation appear to be independent of protein intake, suggesting that it is an integral mediator of the mechanistic/mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) protein complexes that control skeletal muscle protein synthesis [2, 3]. As such, phosphatidic acid ingestion may confer an additive anabolic effect with other muscle-building supplements and adequate protein intake. How To Use As a dietary supplement, mix one scoop (1.5 grams) of Transparent Labs Growth in 4-6 oz of water and consume once daily, preferably on an empty stomach or between meals. This powder may also be taken as a "dry scoop" and washed down with water. Optimal Timing We recommend taking your daily serving of Transparent Labs Growth on an empty stomach 30-45 minutes before exercising. If you use a whey protein powder after working out, this protocol will allow enough time for resensitizing muscle protein synthesis before taking your post-workout whey protein shake. FAQs How Many Servings Are in Each Container of Growth? There are 30 servings per container of Growth. Can I Take Growth with Other Supplements? Yes, absolutely. Phosphatidic acid can generally be taken in conjunction with other supplements, such as protein powders and creatine, without adverse interactions. How Should I Take Growth? Please refer to the "How to Use" section above for instructions on how to take Growth. Are There Any Side Effects of Using Phosphatidic Acid? Phosphatidic acid (PA) supplementation has been extensively studied and found to be safe for both men and women. When used at recommended dosages (typically up to 750 mg daily), it may occasionally cause minimal gastrointestinal side effects. However, as with any supplement, it is advisable you consult a healthcare professional before beginning use, particularly if underlying health conditions exist or take prescription medications. Is Phosphatidic Acid Supplementation Safe to Take for Athletes? Phosphatidic Acid supplementation is generally considered safe for athletes when taken at recommended doses. Studies have shown it to be non-toxic and well-tolerated (e.g., a daily intake of 750 mg over 8 weeks in healthy college-aged individuals). How Long Will It Take to See Results with Phosphatidic Acid? The time it takes to see notable results with phosphatidic acid supplementation can vary, but significant improvements in muscle growth and strength have been documented within an 8-week period in resistance-trained individuals. Consistency in supplementation (i.e. daily use) and a diligent resistance-training regimen are essential for maximizing the benefits of phosphatidic acid. 6921.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Hydrate is a sugar-free electrolyte powder that delivers clinically proven minerals and amino acids to help you stay hydrated throughout the day and during training. For a limited time, try Diana’s exclusive new flavor, or get the full bundle including the TL x Diana signature tumbler. Key Features: Pure Electrolytes for Optimal Hydration: Formulated with a bioavailable electrolyte mixture to promote optimal hydration, including TRAACS® calcium bisglycinate, Aquamin™ magnesium, sodium from Himalayan rock salt, taurine, and natural potassium from organic coconut water powder. Enhanced with Senactiv™: Patented adaptogen complex that supports exercise performance and muscle recovery at the subcellular level. Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, and Naturally Sweetened with Stevia: Sweetened naturally with stevia leaf extract; no added sugar or hidden carbohydrates like other electrolyte supplements. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits Senactiv™ | 50 mg: SenActiv® is a patented, clinically studied ergogenic adaptogen complex that provides highly purified and fractionated extracts of Panax notoginseng and Rosa roxburghii (rose hips). The unique phytochemicals in SenActiv® have been shown to enhance subcellular processes that accelerate muscle recovery after exhaustive exercise [1]. These compounds also possess adaptogenic properties to facilitate athletic performance and healthy aging [2]. Taurine | 1,000 mg: Taurine is a naturally occurring sulfonic acid not abundant in the diet. Supplementing with taurine provides cell-hydrating properties and neuroprotective effects throughout the nervous system [3]. In addition, a recent meta-analysis concluded that taurine can significantly enhance stamina, strength, and power capacity during exercise, and it appears to have a range of cognitive benefits as well [4]. Calcium (as TRAACS® Calcium Bisglycinate and Di-Calcium Phosphate) | 84 mg: Calcium is an essential mineral for enhancing the integrity of bone and promoting the growth, proliferation, and differentiation of bone cells [5]. It’s also a crucial micronutrient in muscles as it associates with mitochondria in muscle cells to stimulate ATP synthesis [6]. To ensure optimal efficacy and absorption, TL Hydrate features TRAACS chelated calcium and dicalcium phosphate, two highly bioavailable forms of supplemental calcium [7]. Magnesium (as Aquamin™ Mg) | 50 mg: Extracted from red algae, Aquamin™ is a natural source of magnesium and 72 other trace minerals. Magnesium is a vital electrolyte mineral that has ubiquitous roles in the body, one of which is regulating muscle contraction [8]. Aquamin® Magnesium provides magnesium in its native ionic state for optimal biocompatibility. Magnesium deficiency is well-known to cause issues with the intestines and often contributes to constipation and dehydration [9]. As such, consuming adequate amounts of bioavailable magnesium is imperative for active individuals. Sodium (as Sodium Citrate and from Himalayan Rock Salt) | 500 mg: Sodium is the primary positive ion (cation) in the fluid outside of cells. It modulates the amount of water in the body and the movement of sodium into and out of cells is essential for proper cell-to-cell signaling. Potassium (as Potassium Citrate, Potassium Chloride, and from Organic Coconut Water) | 250 mg: As a counterpart to sodium, potassium is the primary cationic (positively charged) electrolyte inside cells. The balance of sodium and potassium is particularly important for cellular hydration, and potassium is necessary for intra- and inter-cellular signaling, as well as being a substrate for skeletal muscle contraction. Organic Coconut Water Powder | 500 mg: Coconut water powder removes the sugary and fatty constituents of coconut water while retaining the essential electrolyte micronutrients, such as magnesium, potassium, phosphorus, and sodium. Due to its abundant electrolyte profile, coconut water can rapidly rehydrate athletes after intense exercise, making it ideal for pre-, intra-, and post-workout supplementation [11]. How to Use Designed for before, during, and after your workout sessions, Transparent Labs Hydrate rapidly replenishes electrolytes and supports muscle contractility, endurance, recovery, and cell volumization. Get the most out of this electrolyte powder by following these guidelines: Mixing Instructions Mix one scoop of Transparent Labs Hydrate with 6-8 ounces of water. For a consistent mix, use a shaker cup or water bottle and shake until the powder is fully dissolved. If using more than one scoop at a time, adjust the amount of water accordingly; less water will result in a stronger flavor, and vice versa. Optimal Consumption Times Pre-Workout: Drinking our hydration powder before your workout helps prepare your body for physical activity, ensuring you're well-hydrated from the get-go. Intra-Workout: Sipping electrolytes during your workout is especially useful if you start feeling dehydrated and/or you're a heavy sweater. Post-Workout: Taking a serving of Transparent Labs Hydrate after your workout is also great for recovery and rehydration, helping to replenish lost fluids and electrolytes. FAQs Is it OK to Drink Electrolytes Every Day? While electrolytes are essential for bodily functions, they should be consumed in moderation. Daily intake is recommended for active individuals, but it's important to avoid excessive consumption. How Often Should You Drink Electrolytes? Adults and children over 4 years can safely consume electrolytes daily to support hydration and electrolyte balance, particularly when active or in hot climates

6922.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Mag AM + PM is a comprehensive AM + PM magnesium supplement combination featuring four innovative, scientifically validated forms of bioavailable magnesium, including ATA Mg®, Magtein®, Sucrosomial® Magnesium, and Magnesium Bisglycinate. Magnesium is an integral cofactor for over 300 biochemical reactions in the body, and it is now clear that deficiency of this mineral can lead to a range of physical and mental health issues, hinder athletic performance, and impair recovery [1, 2]. Health-conscious consumers, athletes, and gym-goers are taking an interest in magnesium supplementation due to recent estimates that upwards of 40% of Americans do not consume enough of this key electrolyte mineral, often despite taking a magnesium supplement [3]. Unlike common forms of supplemental magnesium (e.g., magnesium citrate and magnesium oxide), the forms in Mag AM + PM are highly absorbable and gentle on the gastrointestinal tract, making them ideal for ongoing use and maintaining adequate magnesium levels in the body. Key Features Contains 4 Unique Magnesium Forms for Enhanced Absorption: The efficacy of magnesium supplements hinges on the bioavailability of magnesium formulations. Sadly, many commercially available products contain low-quality magnesium salts, which are poorly absorbed and can cause gastrointestinal side effects. The magnesium forms found in Mag AM + PM are gentle on the stomach and have superior absorption kinetics, helping your body absorb and use the magnesium more effectively. Targeted Magnesium Delivery for Systemic Health Benefits: Each form of magnesium in Mag AM + PM has a distinct absorption and metabolism profile designed to complement one another for systemic health benefits, such as supporting brain health, muscle function, sleep quality, and more. 30-Day Supply to Cover Your Daily Magnesium Needs: Mag AM + PM provides 106% of the RDA (recommended daily allowance) for magnesium with just one serving (each) of the AM + PM formulation to easily and effectively increase your magnesium intake. Pure, Quality Ingredients (No Fillers or Nonsense): Consistent with our core values, each batch of Transparent Labs Mag AM + PM is third-party tested for purity, potency, and authenticity. Active Ingredients and Benefits ATA Mg® | 700 mg ATA Mg® (Magnesium N-Acetyl Taurinate) is an innovative, patented form of magnesium produced by combining magnesium with acetyl-taurine, a natural metabolite of taurine. The acetylation of taurine facilitates greater magnesium transport across cell membranes, making magnesium N-acetyl taurinate one of the most intriguing yet underappreciated forms of supplemental magnesium [4]. In addition to being highly bioavailable, magnesium N-acetyl taurinate is a popular subject of recent research, evaluating its impact on cardiovascular function, nervous system function, ocular/vision health, and skeletal muscle recovery. [5, 6, 7]. Preliminary studies are promising and suggest that this specific form of magnesium helps regulate neurotransmitter activity and calm the nervous system [8]. Magtein® | 2,000 mg Magtein® is an innovative, clinically studied magnesium salt that combines magnesium with threonic acid, a naturally occurring metabolite of ascorbic acid (vitamin C). Magnesium L-threonate is distinct from other forms of magnesium in that it has superior bioavailability across the blood-brain barrier; thus, it increases magnesium levels in the brain and cerebrospinal fluid more effectively than other forms of magnesium [9, 10, 11]. The increase in brain magnesium concentrations after taking magnesium L-threonate is consistently associated with improved synaptic density and plasticity in the hippocampus, which is critical for learning and memory [12, 13, 14]. Studies also indicate that this form of magnesium can support neurological health and function through multimodal mechanisms of action (e.g., enhancing mitochondrial density in neurons and bolstering glial cells) [15, 16, 17]. Sucrosomial® Magnesium | 600 mg Sucrosomial® magnesium is the result of nanotechnology advances in recent years that led to the creation of “sucrosomes,” which are cell-like matrices comprised of phospholipids and sucrose esters. The sucrosome protects the encapsulated magnesium ions in a protective layer that passes through the gastrointestinal tract more efficiently, minimizing the degradation that often occurs with other forms of supplemental magnesium [18]. The phospholipid-based coating facilitates absorption into the bloodstream, making it more efficacious [19]. Another advantage of Sucrosomial® magnesium is that it can be taken in large doses without causing adverse GI effects. Magnesium Bisglycinate Chelate | 600mg One of the most bioavailable forms of magnesium is magnesium bisglycinate—a chelated form of magnesium where the mineral is bonded to glycine, an amino acid. This specific form is noted for its superior absorption and minimal gastrointestinal side effects compared to other forms, such as magnesium oxide [20]. The enhanced absorbability of magnesium bisglycinate can be attributed to glycine acting as a transport molecule, facilitating magnesium passage through the intestinal wall. As a result, a greater proportion of ingested magnesium is absorbed into the bloodstream, thereby increasing overall bioavailability. How To Use For Mag AM: Take four (4) capsules daily as a dietary supplement, preferably on an empty stomach in the morning. (This can be taken with a meal if you prefer.) For Mag PM: Take three (3) capsules daily as a dietary supplement, preferably on an empty stomach in the evening. (This can be taken with a meal if you prefer.) Optimal Consumption Times Magnesium can be taken any time of day, but it's generally best to take the AM and PM formulas at their designated timeframes. FAQs How Much Magnesium Should I Take Per Day? You should consume at least the reference daily intake (RDI) of all vitamins as consistently as possible.

6924.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Cognition is a high-performance, evidence-based nootropic supplement featuring four key ingredients that support healthy cognitive function: Rhodiolife® (Rhodiola rosea extract), Cognizin® (citicoline), SerinAid® (phosphatidylserine), and PurCaf® (organic caffeine). This formula also contains B vitamins, L-theanine, and huperzine-A to complement overall brain health. So-called "brain supplements" are myriad nowadays, given the convincing evidence that cognitive and behavioural disturbances can be alleviated with not only prescription drugs but also natural ingredients. However, many brain health supplements lack evidence-based nootropics, instead relying on experimental compounds with questionable efficacy and safety. Our Cognition supplement includes patented and proven ingredients tested in human clinical trials for improving cognitive performance (e.g., working memory and mental alertness), brain function, stress resilience, mood, and more! And with just the right amount of caffeine, Cognition helps you dial in and focus without feeling overstimulated or jittery. Key Features Supports Cognitive Function and Mental Energy: Cognition is meticulously crafted with evidence-based ingredients such as Cognizin®, SerinAid®, and Rhodiolife® that work synergistically to fortify your mental performance and acuity starting with the very first dose. Improves Motivation and Drive: By controlling cortisol levels and supporting dopamine production, Cognition contributes to greater motivation and drive so you can conquer the day ahead. Enhance Stress-Resiliency and Mood: The adaptogens and nootropics in Cognition help the body and brain become more resilient to psychological and physical stressors, encouraging a balanced mood throughout the day. Stackable with Pre-Workout Formulas for Enhanced Focus: Cognition can be stacked with your favorite pre-workout supplement to bolster focus and drive during training. (Note that Cognition provides 100 mg of caffeine per serving, so take this into account when combining with caffeinated pre-workouts.) Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of Cognition is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. Active Ingredients and Benefits Rhodiolife® (Rhodiola rosea Root Extract, 5% Rosavins) | 600 mg Rhodiolife® is the world’s first standardized Rhodiola rosea extract to be made commercially available. This patented ingredient is developed by Nektium Pharma and is 100% identity guaranteed, ensuring authenticity and potency with 5% rosavins and 1.8% salidroside (the key beneficial constituents in Rhodiola). As a prestigious adaptogenic herb, Rhodiola rosea has been increasingly studied as a natural treatment for various mental health conditions (e.g., generalized anxiety disorder and moderate depression) with promising results [1]. The roots of Rhodiola rosea are enriched in numerous phytonutrients—notably rosavins and salidroside—that possess many putative health benefits, including: Improving cognitive deficiencies and depressive symptoms [2, 3] Enhancing the immune system [4] Promoting exercise performance [5, 6] Supporting healthy blood pressure levels and cerebral blood flow [7] Cognizin® Citicholine (CDP-Choline) | 250 mg Cognizin® is a patented form of choline known as citicoline, or cytidine diphosphate (CDP)-choline, the industry’s gold standard for choline supplementation. Choline is an essential B vitamin becoming increasingly scarce in the modern human diet [8]. It plays a vital role in acetylcholine synthesis, the primary neurotransmitter governing cognitive function and mental acuity when handling tasks that demand sharp focus and concentration. While you can find many nootropic supplements with choline, they almost always contain choline bitartrate, which has negligible impact on choline levels in the brain [9]. On the contrary, a recent human clinical trial found that subjects given a CDP-choline supplement experienced a two-fold increase in plasma levels of both choline and uridine for over 10 hours—this improved performance on mentally demanding tasks like memory tests and interpretation [10]. Moreover, choline and uridine work synergistically to synthesize phospholipid precursors that protect brain cells, thereby supporting neuronal function and integrity [11]. SerinAid® (70% Phosphatidylserine) | 200 mg SerinAid® is the purest and most potent phosphatidylserine ingredient on the market, derived exclusively from plant sources. Phosphatidylserine is an important phospholipid that protects neurons and glial cells in the brain and acts as a cellular signaling molecule to keep the mind sharp [11]. Recent research reviews contend phosphatidylserine supplementation may help alleviate mild cognitive impairment and improve memory [12, 13]. Further evidence shows phosphatidylserine administration attenuates stress-induced cortisol spikes, thus supporting mood and adrenal balance [14, 15]. PurCaf® Organic Caffeine (from Green Coffee Bean) | 100 mg While many nootropic supplements contain synthetic caffeine, we formulated Cognition with organic caffeine derived from green coffee beans (as PurCaf®). On the molecular level, caffeine (chemically known as 1,3,7-trimethylxanthine) is an alkaline, organic substance derived from xanthine — a biologically important purine base found in many bodily tissues and fluids. Methylxanthines like caffeine stimulate the central nervous system (CNS) and heart to promote wakefulness and motivation. Numerous studies have shown that taking caffeine can significantly improve overall cognitive performance and may even reduce the risk of neurodegenerative conditions [16, 17]. L-Theanine | 100 mg L-theanine is a green-tea-derived amino acid that readily traverses the blood-brain barrier to exert nootropic effects [18]. 6925.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Cortisol Balance is a comprehensive stress-relief formula featuring clinically studied ingredients, including Shoden® Ashwagandha, SerinAid® phosphatidylserine, Relora® (Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense), and BioPerine® (black pepper fruit extract). These unique adaptogenic herbs and phosphatidylserine support overall well-being and mood by balancing stress hormones, primarily cortisol, and modulating the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis. In turn, this can promote numerous health benefits and reduce stress levels. Key Features Supports Healthy Cortisol Levels and Well-Being: Sometimes life gets crazy, and the stress that comes with it can throw our cortisol levels out of whack. The evidence-based ingredients in Cortisol Balance help turn the table around and make the body more resilient to stress by keeping cortisol levels in check. Relieve Physical and Mental Stress: Elevated cortisol levels are associated with chronic stress, and vice versa. Our Cortisol Balance formula helps manage stress by providing targeted nutrients that modulate the brain and nervous system to lower cortisol levels. Improve Sleep Quality and Immune System Function: When the body produces excess cortisol, it can impair immune function and make it harder to get a good night's rest. By encouraging more stable cortisol levels, Cortisol Balance supports deeper, more restorative sleep and a stronger immune system, ultimately contributing to a healthy lifestyle. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. Active Ingredients and Benefits SerinAid® (70% Phosphatidylserine) | 400 mg SerinAid® is a high-purity form of phosphatidylserine, an essential phospholipid nutrient found in the cell membranes of plants and animals. Research has demonstrated that phosphatidylserine supplementation can attenuate the rise in cortisol levels induced by physical stress, thereby modulating the stress response and promoting a state of calm. For example, a recent study published in the journal Hormone and Metabolic Research found that phosphatidylserine significantly reduced cortisol levels in response to exercise-induced stress, suggesting its promise for stress management. Relora® (Proprietary Blend of Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense) | 250 mg Relora® is a patented blend of extracts from Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense, two botanicals traditionally used in Asian medicine. These extracts have been studied for their potential to mitigate stress and anxiety. Clinical trials indicate that Relora® can effectively reduce cortisol levels and improve mood states in individuals experiencing chronic stress in as few as four weeks. Shoden® Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) | 60 mg Shoden® is a highly potent extract of Ashwagandha, standardized to an unmatched 35% withanolide glycosides. Ashwagandha is a renowned adaptogenic herb that has long been used in Ayurvedic medicine to enhance resilience to stress. The numerous therapeutic properties of ashwagandha stem from its ability to reduce cortisol levels and help the body successfully adapt to stressful conditions . In turn, ashwagandha supplementation may promote mental clarity, a better mood, healthy sexual function, muscle recovery, and more. BioPerine® Black Pepper Fruit Extract | 5 mg BioPerine® is a patented black pepper (Piper nigrum) fruit extract standardized for its piperine content. Piperine is a natural alkaloid known for its “bioenhancer” properties, improving the bioavailability of molecules that are typically poorly absorbed or extensively metabolized in the liver [RR, RR]. How To Use As a dietary supplement, take two (2) capsules one to two times daily, preferably on an empty stomach. Optimal Consumption Times We recommend taking one serving in the mid-morning (between breakfast and lunch) and another serving 1-2 hours before bedtime. FAQs What Are the Benefits of Cortisol Balance? This formula can provide a range of benefits by helping reduce the stress hormone cortisol and promoting overall adrenal function. Cortisol is the primary glucocorticoid in humans. It is a type of steroid hormone produced in the adrenal glands, regulating metabolism, development, immune function, and cognition/alertness. While cortisol is an essential hormone necessary to sustain life, too much (or too little) of it can wreak havoc on bodily systems. Will this Product Fix a Cortisol Imbalance? The answer to this depends on the degree of "imbalance" you're experiencing and numerous other factors (e.g. eating a healthy diet, taking prescription medications, and having underlying health conditions). Since this product is a nutritional supplement, it is not intended to treat, cure, or diagnose any medical conditions. It's important to talk to your doctor if you're concerned about elevated cortisol levels and/or your mental health. Do Anxiety Medications Help with Cortisol? Most anxiety medications target GABA receptors or monoamine transporters (e.g. selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors). These medications may have downstream effects that slightly decrease cortisol levels and reduce stress, but that is not their primary mechanism of action. How Do I Tell if I Have High Cortisol? Your primary care doctor can order the appropriate lab work, such as a salivary cortisol test, to assess your cortisol/adrenal functions. 6926.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Multivitamin is a premium, all-natural, vegan-friendly formula containing essential vitamins and minerals from organic sources that align with your holistic and active lifestyle. This multivitamin is a foundation of wellness and longevity, serving as a daily staple that mimics the biocompatibility of obtaining these essential nutrients from wholesome food sources. It also includes additional sources of plant-based vitamins K1, K2, and D3, which work synergistically to promote skin health, immune function, bone integrity, cardiovascular function, and more. This formula goes the extra mile with LuteMax 20/20®, a patented antioxidant complex featuring 20 mg of lutein and 4 mg of zeaxanthin to promote ocular health/vision and overall cellular integrity. Key Features All-Natural, Organic Multivitamin Formula for Active Adults: Our whole-food multivitamin features naturally occurring micronutrients from organic sources, such as RGen™ herbal extracts, VegD3® Plant-Based Vitamin D, and Biogrown® Vitamin K1 + MenaQ7® Vitamin K2. Biocompatible Micronutrients in a Convenient Once-Daily Dose: Transparent Labs Multivitamin is formulated with biocompatible vitamins and minerals that the body can properly absorb and utilize. Added Ocular/Vision Support Complex: Thanks to LuteMax 20/20®, this multivitamin formula protects vision and overall ocular health with key antioxidants (lutein and zeaxanthin) that are known for preventing macular degeneration. 30 Servings Per Bottle: Our multivitamin supplement provides 30 days worth of servings to help you meet your micronutrient needs with the right vitamins and minerals. Active Ingredients and Benefits Vitamin A (from RGen™ Herbal Extracts)| 150 mcg RAE Beta-carotene is a "pre-vitamin" commonly found in orange-colored vegetables like carrots and sweet potatoes. The body converts beta-carotene into retinol, an active form of vitamin A that supports cell growth and differentiation in the retina, as well as skin and immune health. Vitamin C (as Liposomal Pureway-C® (90mg) and RGen™ Herbal Extracts (50mg) | 140 mg Vitamin C is a ubiquitous antioxidant for collagen synthesis, immune function, and wound healing. It enhances the absorption of non-heme iron from plant-based foods and protects cells from oxidative stress by neutralizing free radicals. Veg D3® Vitamin D3 (as Plant-Based Cholecalciferol) | 25 mcg (1,000 IU) The "sunshine" vitamin is a key regulator of calcium and phosphorus absorption in the gut. It supports bone health, endocrine function, immunity, cell growth, and neuromuscular function. Vitamin E (from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 33.5 mg Vitamin E is a fat-soluble antioxidant that scavenges free radicals, preventing them from damaging cell membranes, DNA, and proteins. This protective effect helps maintain the integrity of cellular and subcellular structures, particularly of the skin, eyes, and immune system. Vitamin K1 and K2 (as BIOGROWN® K1 and MenaQ7® K2) | 300 mcg Vitamin K is a group of fat-soluble vitamins that regulate blood clotting and bone health. These essential nutrients activate proteins involved in blood coagulation and work with vitamin D to regulate calcium deposition in bones and prevent arterial calcification. Vitamin B1 (as Thiamine from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 12.5 mg Thiamine (vitamin B1) is a cofactor involved in energy metabolism, particularly in converting carbohydrates into adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the energy currency of cells. Vitamin B2 (as Riboflavin from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 12.5 mg Riboflavin is a key component of two coenzymes, flavin mononucleotide (FMN) and flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), which are involved in various metabolic reactions. These coenzymes are necessary for converting nutrients from food into energy, thereby supporting the growth and repair of body tissues. Vitamin B3 (as Niacin from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 17.5 mg Niacin is a precursor of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD) and nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP), two key coenzymes for energy production, DNA repair, cell signaling, and maintaining healthy cholesterol levels. Vitamin B6 (from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 25 mg Pyridoxal-5'-phosphate (P5P), the active form of vitamin B6, is involved in over 100 enzymatic reactions, mostly related to protein metabolism. It also plays an important role in neurotransmitter synthesis, red blood cell formation, and homocysteine regulation, thus supporting cardiovascular health. Folate (from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 200 mcg DFE Folate, also known as vitamin B9, is especially important for cell growth and division, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell production. Folate and vitamin B12 are synergistic cofactors in converting homocysteine to methionine. High levels of homocysteine have been linked to an increased risk of heart disease, stroke, and cognitive decline. By working together, folate and B12 help keep homocysteine levels in check, promoting cardiovascular and cognitive health. Vitamin B12 (as Re-Natured® Methylcobalamin) | 2.4 mcg Vitamin B12 is imperative for DNA synthesis, nerve function, and red blood cell formation. It works with folate (vitamin B9) to regulate homocysteine levels and is essential for nervous system health. Nutritional deficits of B12 commonly lead to anemia and neurological issues. Biotin (from RGen™ Herbal Extracts) | 50 mcg Biotin assists with the metabolism of fats, carbohydrates, and proteins. It is particularly important for healthy hair, skin, and nails and for the enzymatic functions of energy production and fatty acid synthesis. Magnesium (as Aquamin® Marine-Sourced Magnesium) | 100 mg Magnesium is an electrolyte mineral and cofactor in over 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It plays an indispensable role in energy production, protein synthesis, muscle and nerve function, and blood glucose control. The marine-sourced citrate form is highly absorbable and supports muscle relaxation and cardiovascular health. Zinc (from
