6929.description_text: Overview If you're having trouble sleeping but want a solution without melatonin, Transparent Labs Sleep & Recover now comes in a melatonin-free formula! The natural ingredients in this non-habit-forming sleep aid, such as L-glycine, VitaCherry®, magnesium, and L-theanine, have been clinically shown to help people fall asleep faster and support restful sleep quality so you wake up feeling refreshed and ready to take on the day—no more sleepless nights tossing and turning until the alarm goes off. Key Features Melatonin-Free Sleep Aid Made with Natural Ingredients: Transparent Labs Sleep & Recover promotes deep sleep and healthy sleep cycles with natural, evidence-based ingredients and no melatonin. This gentle formula is ideal for those who don't respond well to traditional/over-the-counter sleeping pills. Eases Stress/Anxiety So You Can Fall Asleep Faster and Stay Asleep: If you have a hard time sleeping throughout the night, our melatonin-free sleep aid includes ingredients that can alleviate occasional sleeplessness by calming the nervous system before bedtime. 30 Servings Per Bottle = 30 Nights of Good Sleep: Our clinically dosed, melatonin-free sleep aid provides natural ingredients that help you get a good night's rest without any next-day drowsiness that often comes with melatonin-containing sleep aids. Third-Party Tested for Purity and Potency: Our commitment to full product transparency and quality assurance means each batch of Transparent Labs Sleep & Recover undergoes third-party testing to ensure label claims are met. Active Ingredients and Benefits L-Glycine | 1,000 mg L-glycine is a conditionally essential amino acid in humans that plays many roles in cellular physiology and has multifarious beneficial effects on cardiovascular, metabolic, and neurological health [1]. Numerous clinical trials have demonstrated the efficacy of glycine as a natural sleeping aid, even in modest doses (1,000 mg) before bedtime [2, 3]. Evidence suggests glycine acts on N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptors in suprachiasmatic nuclei within the hypothalamus [4]. These tiny nuclei function as a bona fide “pacemaker” of the body’s innate circadian rhythms. VitaCherry® Tart Cherry Powder | 500 mg VitaCherry® is a patented tart cherry (Montmorency cherry) powder standardized to provide a rich profile of beneficial anthocyanins and antioxidant polyphenols, as well as B vitamins, calcium, magnesium, iron, and omega-3 essential fatty acids (EFAs). In fact, VitaCherry® is 15x more concentrated in the specific anthocyanins associated with reducing inflammation after vigorous exercise than generic tart cherry powders. Multiple human studies have shown that tart cherry consumption significantly reduces post-exercise muscle soreness and enhances muscle recovery in high-level athletes [5]. L-Theanine | 200 mg L-theanine is a non-proteinogenic amino acid first discovered as a constituent of green tea (Camellia sinensis) leaves. After ingestion, L-theanine is readily absorbed across the blood-brain barrier, where it exerts several nootropic effects, notably stimulating the release of alpha brainwaves and acting as a GABA receptor agonist [6, 7]. As such, L-theanine helps induce a sense of calmness and ease racing thoughts, which can help people fall asleep and improve sleep quality. Rutaecarpine | 100 mg Rutaecarpine is a major alkaloid isolated from Evodia rutaecarpa. Several studies have shown that it speeds the rate at which caffeine and caffeine derivatives are metabolized, thereby eliminating them from the body more rapidly [8, 9]. Thus, rutaecarpine helps calm the nervous system and “de-caffeinate” the body, which is imperative for restful sleep if you regularly drink coffee, pre-workouts, energy drinks, or other caffeinated beverages later in the day/evening. Magnesium Bisglycinate | 200 mg Magnesium is a macromineral electrolyte and cofactor (read: "helping hand") in over 350 enzymatic reactions in the human body. Its multifaceted roles make it essential for numerous body functions, including energy metabolism, protein synthesis, neuromuscular conduction, mood, cognition, cardiac contractility, and immunity [10]. Several clinical studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of magnesium glycinate supplements (including the bisglycinate form) for promoting restorative sleep and ameliorating sleep conditions such as insomnia [11]. The magnesium bisglycinate in this melatonin-free sleep aid does not cause a laxative effect in large doses and is gentle on the gastrointestinal tract, unlike other common forms of magnesium (e.g. magnesium oxide and magnesium citrate). Zinc Citrate | 15 mg Like magnesium, zinc is an essential mineral typically lacking in modern diets [19]. Our melatonin-free sleep aid contains bioavailable zinc citrate to ensure your body can absorb this key trace mineral. Zinc deficiency is well-known to disrupt immune function, fertility, sex hormone production, mood, and sleep quality [20]. On the contrary, supplementing with a combination of zinc, magnesium, and vitamin B6 has been shown to confer synergistic sleep and recovery benefits, ideal for active individuals who struggle to get restful sleep [21]. Vitamin B6 (as Pyridoxal-5'-Phosphate) | 10 mg Vitamin B6 is a water-soluble vitamin with extensive roles throughout the nervous system. In its bioactive pyridoxal-5-phosphate (PLP) form, it acts as a coenzyme in the conversion of tryptophan to 5-hydroxytryptamine (i.e. serotonin), which is a precursor of melatonin synthesis [22, 23]. This suggests that a deficiency of PLP may impair sleep quality and contribute to occasional sleeplessness. Indeed, several studies have found that circulating PLP levels are inversely associated with sleep quality and sleeplessness [24, 25]. In other words, people with higher levels of PLP tend to sleep better and experience less daytime drowsiness. 6930.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Dopamine+ is a dietary supplement featuring natural ingredients that support dopamine levels. Dopamine, often referred to as the "feel-good" neurotransmitter, plays a critical role in our mood, motivation, and focus. This stimulant-free formula contains clinically studied nutrients such as Sabroxy®, Cognizin®, and L-tyrosine to support the body's endogenous dopamine production and promote mental acuity, cognitive function, and focus without the associated mood swings and crashes that often come from using stimulant-based dopamine agonists. Key Features Naturally Supports Dopamine Neurotransmission: The ingredients in Transparent Labs Dopamine + naturally promote your body's dopamine production throughout the day. Dopamine is a vital neurotransmitter (chemical messenger) throughout the brain and body that regulates mood, drive, attention span, and much more. Three-Pronged Mode of Action: The ingredients in this formula work by providing essential dopamine precursors, inhibiting dopamine reuptake, and modulating dopamine receptors. These converging mechanisms of action allow for comprehensive dopamine production and neurotransmission. Non-Stimulant Formula: Transparent Labs Dopamine+ is a stimulant-free formula that can be taken in the morning, afternoon, or early evening without interrupting sleep. 30 Clinically Dosed Servings Per Bottle: Each bottle of Transparent Labs Dopamine+ contains 30 full doses to ensure efficacy and quality at an exceptional value. Active Ingredients and Benefits L-Tyrosine | 1,500 mg L-tyrosine is a conditionally essential amino acid and precursor to dopamine and norepinephrine, two neurotransmitters that govern motivation and reward. Research shows that supplementing with L-tyrosine can significantly enhance cognitive performance, especially under acutely stressful situations (like cramming the night before an exam) [1]. L-Tyrosine has also been shown to improve “cognitive flexibility,” meaning it can help you adapt to changing cognitive demands and block extraneous thoughts [2].Another study found that L-tyrosine improves "deep/critical thinking" rather than brainstorming (divergent thinking) [3]. Sabroxy® (Oroxylum indicum) Extract (bark) (10% Oroxylin A) | 500 mg Sabroxy® is a patented herbal extract of Oroxylum indicium that has been shown to possess neuroprotective and cognition-enhancing properties [4]. This specific extract is standardized to contain a minimum 10% oroxylin A, a flavonoid that can inhibit dopamine reuptake, thereby increasing synaptic dopamine levels between nerve cells (neurons) [5]. This mechanism of action supports focus, attention, and cognitive function. Cognizin® Citicoline (CDP-Choline) | 250 mg Cognizin® is a patented form of cytidine diphosphate (CDP)-choline, also known as citicoline, that plays a dual role in supporting cognitive function. First, it provides bioavailable choline to support acetylcholine synthesis, a neurotransmitter involved in memory and learning [6]. Second, citicoline supports the production of phosphatidylcholine, a key phospholipid of brain cell membranes, enhancing neuronal communication and dopamine receptor function [7]. Saffron (7.5% Crocins, 1% Safranals) | 30 mg Saffron, the dried stigma of Crocus sativus, has been traditionally used for its mood-enhancing properties. Crocins and safranals, the active constituents of saffron, have been shown to increase dopamine levels and improve mood [8]. These compounds can help alleviate symptoms of depression and anxiety, further supporting a focused and positive mental state [9]. Vitamin B6 (as Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate) | 0.44 mg Vitamin B6 is a vital cofactor in the synthesis of neurotransmitters, including dopamine. It facilitates the conversion of L-DOPA to dopamine by acting as a coenzyme, thereby enhancing mood and cognitive function [10]. Folate (Vitamin B9) | 400 mcg DFE Folate is another essential B vitamin for neurotransmitter production. Specifically, it participates in methylation reactions essential for synthesizing dopamine [11]. Folate's role in maintaining homocysteine levels also supports brain health, further contributing to improved focus and mental clarity [12]. How To Use As a dietary supplement, take 4 capsules on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning or afternoon. Optimal Consumption Times Transparent Labs Dopamine+ is a stimulant-free formula that can be taken in the morning, afternoon, or early evening without interrupting sleep. However, it is generally advisable to avoid taking this product within 3-4 hours of bedtime as heightened dopamine activity can make it harder to fall asleep. FAQs Will This Product Help with Dopamine Deficiency? Dopamine deficiency is known to cause numerous physical and mental health conditions (e.g. Parkinson's disease). While the ingredients in Transparent Labs Dopamine+ can help increase dopamine levels, this product is not intended to treat any medical conditions. Can Dopamine Supplements Interact with Other Medications? Yes. If you currently take dopamine agonist medications or other medications, you should consult with your healthcare provider before taking dopamine supplements, as they may heighten the effects of the medications you're using. Transparent Labs Dopamine+ is not intended as a substitute for any prescription medications. Can I Take Dopamine Supplements with Other Dietary Supplements? Yes, Transparent Labs Dopamine+ can be taken with most dietary supplements without harm. However, the answer to this question depends on the specific ingredients in the other dietary supplements you're using. Do Dopamine Pills Require a Prescription? Transparent Labs Dopamine+ does not contain any substances that are considered drugs and, therefore, does not require a prescription. However, you should consult a healthcare professional before taking any dopamine-related supplements if you're currently taking any prescription medications, especially dopamine agonists. 6931.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Pea Protein Isolate is a delicious, USDA-certified organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, plant-based protein powder providing 28 grams of complete protein per serving. Our pea protein powder is made from organic yellow peas and packs 28 grams of protein per serving to help vegans and vegetarians meet their protein intake needs and fitness goals. This protein can also be used in almost any diet and combined with other protein supplements, like whey protein powders. As a complete protein source, pea protein powder contains all nine essential amino acids (and a generous amount of branched-chain amino acids) to facilitate muscle protein synthesis and support muscle growth and recovery. It's also virtually sugar-free, easily digested, and contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners (e.g. acesulfame potassium and aspartame), artificial food coloring, or artificial flavoring. Key Features USDA-Certified Organic Pea Protein Powder: We source our pea protein isolate from USDA-certified organic yellow split peas that provide highly bioavailable protein and a complete amino acid profile to support muscle mass, body composition, and overall health. Provides 28 Grams of Complete Protein Per Scoop: Just one scoop (~38 g) of Transparent Labs Pea Protein powder packs 28 grams of high-quality protein, ideal for post-workout recovery or any time you need a simple, tasty way to get extra protein throughout the day. Simple, Healthy Way to Increase Protein Intake on a Plant-Based Diet: If you're looking for an excellent alternative to animal-based protein powders, our pea protein powder is the answer. In addition to being naturally gluten-free and dairy-free, the protein in yellow peas is a rich source of dietary iron and calcium, two minerals that may be lacking in a plant-based diet. No Artificial Flavoring, Artificial Sweeteners, or Artificial Food Coloring: We know you care about what you put in your body, and far too often protein supplements are jam-packed with unnecessary additives. This is why Transparent Labs Pea Protein powder is made with all-natural flavoring and sweetened with stevia extract. Delicious Vanilla and Chocolate Flavors: Protein powders, especially plant-based varieties, are notorious for their gritty texture and lackluster flavor. Our goal with Transparent Labs Pea Protein Isolate was to make a vegan protein powder that mixes easily, tastes great, and has a smooth texture. After all, who said protein shakes have to taste like watered-down chalk? Active Ingredients and Benefits *Doses listed are per serving (~39 grams) Organic Pea Protein Isolate | 36.6 grams Transparent Labs Pea Protein powder features organic pea protein isolate derived from whole yellow split peas (Pisum sativum), a common dietary legume native to Eurasia. Yellow split peas are naturally rich in vitamin C, calcium, iron, magnesium, and dietary fiber. However, the protein content of whole peas is relatively low, at just 8 grams per 100-gram portion, so consuming an adequate amount of protein from whole peas is somewhat impractical. This is where pea protein powder comes in handy since it contains mostly protein and micronutrients found in whole peas without all the carbohydrates, making it an excellent option for plant-based diets. Like whey protein, pea protein is technically a complete protein [1]. Pea protein has a lower amount of branched-chain amino acids compared to whey protein, so a slightly higher intake of pea protein is necessary to achieve a commensurate anabolic response [2]. The major storage proteins of peas are globulins which are further classified as legumin, vicilin, and convicilin, each of which is characteristically high in the essential amino acid lysine, which is commonly lacking in other plant proteins [3]. While peas get criticized for having a low proportion of methione (another essential amino acid), this characteristic is one reason that pea protein powder is only weakly acidic—unlike animal proteins—and promotes an alkaline state [4]. Moreover, pea protein is rich in isoflavones that may play a role in reducing the risk of cancer, lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure, and fighting inflammation [5, 6]. How To Use As a dietary supplement, add one (1) scoop of Transparent Labs Pea Protein Isolate with 6-8 oz of water or plant-based milk and mix thoroughly before consuming. We recommend consuming 1-3 scoops per day to help meet your protein demands. Mixing Instructions Transparent Labs Pea Protein Isolate mixes best by using a blender or shaker bottle. It can also be added to recipes for baked goods and semi-soft foods, like oatmeal and yogurt. Optimal Consumption Times The complete amino acid profile of yellow split peas makes pea protein powder an exceptional way to kickstart muscle recovery after exercise. However, pea protein powder is a quality protein source that can be consumed any time to help you meet your protein intake goal. FAQ`s What is Pea Protein Isolate? Pea protein isolate is simply protein isolated from whole peas. It is made by extracting the protein from whole peas, leaving behind most of the starch and sugar. Is Pea Protein Isolate Suitable for Vegans and Vegetarians? Yes, our pea protein powder is ideal for vegans and vegetarians who want a simple, healthy way to increase protein intake. No milk or other animal products are used to make pea protein. How Do I Use Pea Protein Isolate? Please refer to the "How to Use" section above. Is Pea Protein Isolate Allergen-Free? It depends on the allergen(s) in question. While peas are generally considered to be hypoallergenic, there is evidence of type-1 allergic reactions to food products containing peas (though this is rare) [7]. Can Pea Protein Isolate Help with Muscle Recovery and Muscle Growth? Absolutely! 6932.description_text: Overview Cyanidin 3-glucoside (C3G) is a potent antioxidant belonging to a class of flavonoids known as anthocyanins. Like other anthocyanins, cyanidin-3-glucoside is an organic pigment that gives various fruits, vegetables, and plants distinctive red, purple, and blue tones. Transparent Labs C3G supplement contains 300 mg of purified cyanidin 3-glucoside per serving, whereas common food sources of C3G, notably berries, may only provide a few milligrams per 100-gram serving. As such, achieving therapeutic doses of cyanidin 3-glucoside via food alone can be challenging, if not impractical. Our C3G supplement makes it easier to reap the metabolic, cognitive, neurological, anti-inflammatory, and body composition benefits of this versatile anthocyanin. Key Features Purified and Highly Concentrated Cyanidin 3-Glucoside (C3G) Supplement: Transparent Labs C3G capsules are a single-active-ingredient formula that provides 300 mg C3G per serving, equal to the amount of C3G in nearly one pound of fresh blackberries (one of the most dense food sources of C3G). With 90 capsules (30 servings) per bottle, this C3G supplement is priced to be an exceptional, high-quality addition to your healthy lifestyle. Versatile Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Nutrient: Like other anthocyanins, cyanidin 3-glucoside has a strong antioxidant capacity, neutralizing free radicals (e.g. reactive oxygen species) that can harm cellular integrity and function. It also possesses anti-inflammatory properties by modulating pro-inflammatory cytokines, such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha. Enhances Insulin Sensitivity/Glucose Uptake and Fat-Burning Gene Expression: Cyanidin 3-glucoside is gaining traction as a potential adjunct in the treatment of various metabolic disorders (e.g. type-2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome) due to its positive impact on insulin sensitivity and thermogenesis (i.e. calorie-burning). Thus, taking a C3G supplement may help combat fat gain and support healthy body composition. Third-Party Tested for Purity, Potency, and Authenticity: Our commitment to full product transparency and quality assurance means each batch of Transparent Labs C3G capsules undergoes third-party testing to ensure each serving meets or exceeds the label claim of 300 mg cyanidin 3-glucoside. Active Ingredients and Benefits Cyanidin 3-Glucoside | 300 mg Cyanidin 3-glucoside (C3G) is a naturally occurring anthocyanin, which is a type of flavonoid pigment responsible for the red, purple, and blue hues in various fruits and vegetables. Chemically, C3G is classified as a glycoside, consisting of the anthocyanidin cyanidin coupled with a glucose (sugar) moiety. Its molecular structure engenders high solubility in water, allowing for efficient absorption in the upper digestive tract. Additionally, C3G has high bioavailability and can readily traverse cell membranes and biological barriers, including the blood-brain barrier, which underpins its versatile therapeutic potential throughout the body.Among the most notable benefits of C3G is its antioxidant properties. By neutralizing free radicals, C3G can reduce oxidative stress and mitigate damage to cellular structures and biologically important molecules [2]. Uncontrolled oxidative stress is a well-known culprit for numerous disease states, including cardiovascular disease, type-2 diabetes, and cancer [3].Aside from its antioxidant role, cyanidin 3-glucoside appears to have extensive and tissue-specific mechanisms of action. While we won't go into specific details herein, for the sake of brevity, it's important to note that C3G has been shown to modulate several key biochemical pathways and physiological processes that regulate weight/composition, insulin sensitivity/blood glucose levels, nitric oxide production, inflammatory response, neurological function, visual acuity, and more [4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]. How to Use Take 3 capsules daily, preferably before a meal earlier in the day. 6933.description_text: Product Overview Transparent Labs Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate is sourced from grass-fed American dairy cattle raised without the use of growth factors or hormones. Get 5 of our best-selling flavors in this variety pack! Try Milk Chocolate, French Vanilla, Strawberry Milkshake, Chocolate Peanut Butter, and Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookie! We are proud to offer the cleanest protein in the world, with absolutely no artificial sweeteners, fillers, food dyes, gluten, or preservatives, and certified by Labdoor with a score of 98 out of 100. In addition, this naturally fed, hormone-free whey protein isolate contains one of the industry’s highest protein-by-weight percentages at 87.5% (28 grams of protein per 32-gram serving). It's the perfect protein source for those who want to support recovery and muscle growth (and those who want a convenient way to add more high-quality protein to their diet). Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate 28 g Grass-fed whey protein isolate provides easily digestible, rapidly absorbed protein with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it ideal for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate × Close 28 g The quality of protein matters, and whey protein isolate is one of the purest forms of protein available. It provides a high protein content with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it an exceptional choice for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. In contrast to whey protein concentrate, whey protein isolate undergoes further filtration to remove virtually all of the lactose, making it more suitable for those who have difficulty digesting lactose.Whey protein isolate is known for its rapid absorption and ideal ratio of all nine essential amino acids (EAAs)—which includes the branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs)—necessary for stimulating muscle protein synthesis [1, 2]. In other words, whey protein isolate is about as good as it gets for kickstarting the muscle-building process after working out. By providing essential nutrients needed for muscle repair, whey isolate can reduce recovery time, allowing for more consistent and intense training sessions.So, why does the "grass-fed" distinction matter for whey protein powder? The vast majority of whey protein powders are made from the milk of grain-fed cows, whereas grass-fed whey protein is derived from the milk of cows that graze on natural, pesticide-free grass pastures instead of feeding on grains. Grass-feeding positively impacts the nutritional composition and quality of a cow's milk and milk byproducts. Here’s why these benefits matter for improving body composition: 1. Supporting Basal Metabolic Rate: In order to lose weight, you must be in an energy (calorie) deficit. The ingredients in PhysiqueSeries Recomp Stim-Free, such as clinically studied Capsimax® and Paradoxine®, help tilt the energy-balance scales in your favor by promoting energy expenditure through mechanisms that naturally bolster metabolic rate. In other words, this formula helps you burn more calories, ultimately contributing to a calorie deficit. 2. Reducing Hunger Cravings: One of the more challenging aspects of losing weight is controlling the urge to eat since the body will naturally have cravings as you become leaner. As such, we formulated PhysiqueSeries Recomp Stim-Free with natural appetite suppressants. For example, Capsimax® contains capsaicinoids derived from red chili peppers which are suggested to help reduce appetite and increase feelings of fullness by increasing norepinephrine after meals. This is especially helpful when reducing calorie intake to facilitate weight loss. 3. Promoting Energy and Focus: It's normal to feel low on energy and mentally foggy during periods of body transformation, which is where nootropics like L-theanine come in handy. 6936.description_text: Overview If you're tired of protein bars loaded with artificial ingredients, sugar alcohols, and harsh fiber sources, Transparent Labs Protein+ Bars are a clean, guilt-free way to get more protein in your diet no matter where life takes you. The Protein+ Bar provides complete nutrition from real-food ingredients, making it a perfect meal or snack whenever you're in a pinch, traveling, or want to indulge in a macro-friendly treat after hitting the gym. Protein+ Bars pack 15-16 grams of protein from grass-fed whey and egg whites, 20-23 grams of whole-food carbohydrates, and 15-17 grams of healthy fats in three mouthwatering flavors to keep your muscles and taste buds satisfied. (*Macros vary slightly between flavor options.) Key Features Complete Nutrition On-The-Go: Protein bars have traditionally not been a great way to get more protein throughout the day due to all the added and often deceptive junk in the formulas. We've taken a different approach with Protein+ Bars by creating a macro-friendly, tasty, real-food-based protein bar that provides a balanced profile of quality protein, essential fats, and wholesome carbohydrates. Features Grass-Fed Whey and Egg White Protein: Protein+ Bars don't cut corners with cheap protein sources like most protein bars. Each Protein+ Bar packs 15 grams of complete protein from grass-fed whey isolate and egg whites, arguably two of the best protein sources for muscle recovery. No Gut-Wrenching Fibers, Artificial Sweeteners, or Sugar Alcohols: Unlike the majority of protein bars on the market, the Protein+ Bar is made with easily digestible, whole-food-based, non-GMO ingredients. This protein bar is also free from sugar alcohols, artificial sweeteners, and cheap fiber sources that leave your gut in knots. Three Decadent Flavors to Satisfy Your Taste Buds: Protein+ Bars, made exclusively with natural ingredients, complete protein, and low added sugar content, so you can indulge without compromising your health and fitness goals. Choose from delicious chocolate peanut butter, dark chocolate almond, and oatmeal chocolate chip flavors 12 Bars Per Box: Each box of Protein+ Bars comes with 12 bars to help you reach protein intake goals and stay on track no matter how busy life gets. Ingredients and Benefits Ingredients May Vary Depending on Flavour*** Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate Grass-fed whey protein isolate is a complete protein source that's rapidly absorbed and easily digestible. Being derived from the milk of grass-fed cows, our whey protein isolate is an excellent source of essential amino acids and branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), which are crucial for muscle repair and growth [1]. Egg White Protein Egg white protein is another exceptional complete protein source that promotes muscle repair; in fact, egg whites have the highest attainable protein-digestibility corrected amino acid score (PDCAAS) [2]. They are also a good source of B vitamins and selenium. Natural Peanut Butter Natural peanut butter contains a generous amount of protein, healthy fats, and fiber, which promote satiety and heart health. It is also rich in vitamins E and B3, as well as minerals like magnesium, supporting overall micronutrient intake without the added sugar or hydrogenated trans-fat found in more processed versions. Natural Almond Butter Almonds are a nutrient-dense nut packed with heart-healthy monounsaturated fats, protein, and dietary fiber, making them a perfect complement to our protein bars. Almonds are also nutritious due to their magnesium and antioxidant content, which are commonly lacking in the diet. Dairy-Free Chocolate Chips Made with unsweetened chocolate, cocoa butter, and a small amount of cane sugar, these dairy-free chocolate chips provide the rich sweetness and flavor of traditional chocolate chips without using any milk products and have low sugar content. Dates Dates come packed with fiber, potassium, and essential trace minerals like copper and manganese. They also provide a wholesome, natural sweetness to our Protein+ Bars. Gluten-Free Rolled Oats Gluten-free rolled oats are a heart-healthy carbohydrate source that provides soluble fiber and sustained energy. They also contain an array of antioxidant micronutrients and essential minerals to promote overall wellness. Coconut Oil Coconut oil is a dense source of medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), a class of "healthy" saturated fats that support metabolism and energy production [3]. It also imparts the Protein+ Bar with a softer texture. Honey Honey is a natural sweetener with a diverse nutritional profile, including trace amounts of vitamins, minerals, enzymes, amino acids, and antioxidants. Unlike refined sugars, honey contains flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its antioxidant properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory effects. Its lower glycemic index than table sugar means it has a more stable impact on blood sugar levels. Tapioca Syrup Tapioca syrup, derived from the starch of the cassava root, is a natural sweetener that offers a gluten-free alternative to corn syrup. The body rapidly absorbs tapioca syrup, providing a quick energy boost to keep you moving. Sea Salt Sea salt is less processed than regular table salt and more flavorful, so its inclusion in the Protein+ Bar was a no-brainer. Sea salt is a natural source of numerous electrolyte minerals, notably magnesium, sodium, and potassium, adding not only a dash of flavor but also essential micronutrients to the final product. How To Use Open the wrapper, remove the bar, take a bite, and try not to eat it all at once! After removal from the wrapper, Protein+ Bars can be placed on a plate or napkin and microwaved for 15-20 seconds for a softer, melt-in-your-mouth treat. Optimal Consumption Times Protein+ Bars can be eaten any time you want a healthy meal or snack, but we typically recommend eating them after a workout or when you don't have time to eat a whole-food meal. 6938.description_text: Overview Sleep is essential for health, longevity, and performance. In fact, sleep is when the body does the majority of its muscle building and recovery. If you want to maximize your results in the gym, you need quality sleep each and every night, which is precisely what Transparent Labs Sleep Aid helps you achieve. This non-habit-forming sleep aid features clinical doses of proven ingredients, such as VitaCherry®, L-theanine, bioavailable minerals, L-glycine, rutaecarpine, and melatonin. This formula is designed with synergy in mind, allowing you to repair, recover, and grow while you’re catching some Z’s. Best of all, Transparent Labs Sleep Aid won’t leave you feeling groggy or “hungover” the next morning. Ingredient Profile Vitamin B (as Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate) | 10 mg Magnesium (As Magnesium Taurinate) | 70 mg Zinc (As Zinc Citrate) | 15 mg L-Glycine | 1,000 mg Tart Cherry (as VitaCherry®) | 500 mg L-Theanine | 200 mg Rutaecarpine | 100 mg Melatonin | 500 mcg Microactive® Melatonin | 1.5 mg How to Use As a dietary supplement, take 4 capsules on an empty stomach 45 minutes before going to sleep. Q. Is This Product Vegan? Yes. WellnessSeries Sleep Aid is vegan. Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. L-Glycine 1,000 mg Glycine is a dietary amino acid that has been shown to enhance sleep quality by regulating circadian rhythms. VitaCherry® Tart Cherry Powder 500 mg The Montmorency cherry (aka tart cherry) is a concentrated source of anthocyanins that promote muscle recovery and restful sleep. L-Theanine 200 mg First discovered in green tea, L-theanine is an amino acid that readily traverses the blood-brain barrier and induces more restful brainwave activity. Rutaecarpine 100 mg Rutaecarpine is a plant-derived compound that helps metabolize caffeine faster, making it ideal for those who consume caffeine later in the day. Magnesium Bisglycinate 200 mg A chelated and highly bioavailable source of magnesium, which is well-known to calm the adrenal glands and make it easier to relax. Zinc Citrate 15 mg Zinc is an essential mineral that modulates immune function, hormonal health, and sleep quality through multiple mechanisms of action. Vitamin B6 (as Pyridoxal-5’-Phosphate) 10 mg Pyridoxal-5’-phosphate (P5P) is the bioactive form of vitamin B6, and it is essential for serotonin production and indirectly supporting natural melatonin synthesis in the pineal gland. Melatonin (as MicroActive® melatonin and standard melatonin) 2 mg combined Melatonin is a natural peptide hormone that the brain produces when we’re exposed to dark environments, such as after the sun goes down. It’s primary role in the body is regulating the sleep-wake cycle. L-Glycine × Close 1,000 mg L-glycine is a conditionally essential amino acid in humans that plays many roles in cellular physiology and has multifarious beneficial effects on cardiovascular, metabolic, and neurological health [1]. Numerous clinical trials have demonstrated the efficacy of glycine as a natural sleeping aid, even in modest doses (1,000 mg) before bedtime [2, 3]. Evidence suggests glycine acts on N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptors in suprachiasmatic nuclei within the hypothalamus [4]. These tiny nuclei function as a bona fide “pacemaker” of the body’s innate circadian rhythms. VitaCherry® Tart Cherry Powder × Close 500 mg VitaCherry® is a patented tart cherry (Montmorency cherry) powder standardized to provide a rich profile of beneficial anthocyanins and antioxidant polyphenols, as well as B vitamins, calcium, magnesium, iron, and omega-3 essential fatty acids (EFAs). L-Theanine × Close 200 mg L-theanine is a non-proteinogenic amino acid first discovered as a constituent of green tea (Camellia sinensis) leaves. After ingestion, L-theanine is readily absorbed across the blood-brain barrier, where it exerts several nootropic effects, notably stimulating the release of alpha brainwaves and acting as a GABA receptor agonist [6, 7].As such, L-theanine helps induce a sense of calmness and ease racing thoughts, which can help people fall asleep and improve sleep quality. Rutaecarpine × Close 100 mg Rutaecarpine is a major alkaloid isolated from Evodia rutaecarpa. Several studies have shown that it speeds the rate at which caffeine and caffeine derivatives are metabolized, thereby eliminating them from the body more rapidly [8, 9]. Thus, rutaecarpine helps calm the nervous system and “de-caffeinate” the body, which is imperative for restful sleep if you regularly drink coffee, pre-workouts, energy drinks, or other caffeinated beverages later in the day/evening. 6939.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Bulk Black is the pinnacle of a clinically dosed pre-workout supplement for stim lovers. If you have experience with our regular Bulk Pre-Workout formula but want some extra "pep" in your step, this is the pre-workout for you. Each scoop of Bulk Black packs over 17 grams of proven nitric oxide boosters, hard-hitting nootropics, natural testosterone-supporting ingredients, and muscle fortifiers dosed according to scientific evidence, so you can bring the noise every time you walk into the gym. Like all Transparent Labs pre-workout formulas, Bulk Black contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, flavors, food dyes, or added sugars. Key Features Evidence-Based "Hardcore" Pre-Workout for Lean Muscle Gain: Like the regular Bulk Pre-Workout formula, Bulk Black features a comprehensive lineup of science-backed active ingredients to help dedicated athletes and gym-goers build muscle mass and perform at peak capacity. Experience Intense Muscle Pumps with Proven Nitric Oxide Boosters: Bulk Black Pre-Workout contains clinical doses of L-citrulline, beta-alanine, and betaine anhydrous to enhance blood flow and give you those oh-so-satisfying, intense muscle pumps during training. Stimulates Mental Sharpness, Focus, Drive, and Energy: Get into the "zone" every time you hit the gym with nootropics backed by scientific evidence, like alpha-GPC (AlphaSize®), caffeine (PurCaf®), L-tyrosine, and taurine. Bulk black pre-workout contains just the right amount of hard-hitting nootropics to deliver a psychotropic rush without the dreaded post-workout crash. Epic All-Natural Flavors Sweetened with Stevia: Many other pre-workout formulas are laden with artificial sweeteners, food dyes, and unnecessary fillers. We know you care about what you put in your body, so Bulk Black Pre-Workout contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, added sugars, or food dyes, and the formula is naturally sweetened with stevia. Choose from multiple refreshing flavor options, including Black Cherry, Cherry kiwi, Peach Mango, Blue Raspberry, Watermelon Peach, Blueberry Pomegranate, and Sour Gummy. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits *Doses listed are per serving (1 full scoop) L-Citrulline Malate (2:1) | 8,000 mg L-citrulline is an amino acid naturally found in watermelon that plays an important role in kidney function. It's become a popular ingredient in pre-workout supplements due to its ability to boost nitric oxide levels [1]. When nitric oxide production increases, blood flow improves, allowing nutrients and oxygen to replenish muscle tissue more efficiently. Ultimately, this translates to greater muscle pumps and heightened energy levels. Numerous studies have demonstrated the ergogenic effects of L-citrulline malate, the citrulline salt of malic acid, such as: Improving strength, aerobic performance, and muscle endurance [2, 3] Elevating nitric oxide levels even more than equivalent doses of L-arginine [4] Enhancing muscle anabolism and reducing muscle catabolism [5] Beta-Alanine | 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is a beta-amino acid that combines with L-histidine to form a dipeptide known as carnosine. Supplementing with beta-alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine levels, which are quickly depleted during intense exercise [6]. Carnosine is an endogenous dipeptide that functions as a buffer in muscle cells, thereby attenuating the accumulation of acidic byproducts of muscular exertion (e.g. lactate and hydrogen ions) [7]. Hence, bolstering muscle carnosine levels—via beta-alanine—allows you to push yourself longer and harder in the gym. Pre-workout supplements almost always contain beta-alanine but in inefficacious doses. We made sure to include a full clinical dose of beta-alanine (4,000 mg) in every scoop of BULK Pre-Workout. Relevant evidence-based benefits of beta-alanine include: Delaying the onset of neuromuscular fatigue during intense exercise [8] Increasing overall muscle strength [9] Improving muscle endurance and total work capacity [10] Reducing and combatting the formation of dysfunctional proteins and promoting the formation of healthy proteins [11] Significantly increasing lean muscle mass as part of a diligent resistance-training program [12] *Note that beta-alanine causes a benign tingling sensation known as paresthesia while the body acclimates to higher carnosine levels. This effect is harmless and gradually lessens with consistent use. BetaPure™ Betaine Anhydrous | 2,500 mg Betaine, also known as trimethylglycine, is a naturally occurring metabolite that serves as a methyl donor and osmolyte in the body. Though the mechanisms are not entirely understood, betaine supplementation has shown promise in enhancing power output and, to a lesser extent, endurance capacity in athletes [13, 14, 15]. It is plausible that betaine supplementation promotes athletic performance by maintaining cellular hydration and reducing homocysteine levels, thereby encouraging healthy cardiovascular function and blood flow [16]. Taurine | 1,300 mg Taurine is another staple pre-workout ingredient with diverse benefits for athletes and gym-goers. For one, taurine is a potent nootropic that confers synergy with caffeine to promote focus and reduce brain cell inflammation and oxidative stress [17, 18]. Taurine can also enhance physical performance via increased blood flow to skeletal muscle tissue [19, 20]. Greater blood flow to muscle tissue encourages a favorable milieu for muscle function and recovery during training. Additionally, taurine supplementation has been shown to improve performance in endurance athletes [21]. L-Tyrosine | 1,000

6940.description_text: Overview Medicinal mushrooms are a culinary delicacy in various cultures, but they remain a nutritional oversight in the modern Western diet (likely due to their cost). Needless to say, there’s considerable untapped potential if you don’t regularly consume them. This is why we formulated Transparent Labs Mushroom Stack with organic reishi, lion’s mane, and Cordyceps sinensis — three of the most promising medicinal mushrooms on the planet. The mushrooms in TL Mushroom Stack are packed with bioactive constituents that promote overall health and longevity through diverse mechanisms across multiple body systems, especially the immune, gastrointestinal, and nervous systems. These prized fungal species have an immense and ever-growing body of clinical evidence behind them, reinforcing their use as traditional medicines throughout human history. Ingredient Profile Organic Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum) | 500mg CordycepsPrime™ (Cordyceps sinensis) | 500mg Organic Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus) | 1,000mg How to Use Take 3 capsules daily as a dietary supplement, preferably on an empty stomach or as directed by your healthcare practitioner. FAQs Q. When will my order be shipped out? All orders ship out the following business day. Q. Does Transparent Labs ship to my Country? Transparent Labs ships Worldwide, except to the following countries, unfortunately, due to increasingly high fraudulent activity; Albania, Algeria, India, Lithuania, Macedonia, Romania, Russia, Tunisia, & Ukraine. Q. Does this product contain nuts? We process products in our facility that have nuts (coconuts, peanuts). However, we have an allergen control program in place that sanitizes and cleans our equipment between allergen and non-allergen runs! Q. Is this product vegan? Yes. WellnessSeries Shroom Stack is vegan. Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Organic CordycepsPrime™ 500 mg Cordyceps sinensis has been used for over six centuries in Asian cultures for stimulating appetite, energy, libido, immunity, and stamina. Organic Reishi Mushroom (Ganoderma Lucidum) 500 mg A large, tough mushroom that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote liver and immune function. Organic Lion’s Mane 1,000 mg Lion’s Mane is a neuroprotective mushroom that supports cognitive function, memory, and gastrointestinal health. Organic CordycepsPrime™ × Close 500 mg Cordyceps mushrooms have been used for over six centuries in Asian cultures for stimulating appetite, energy, libido, immunity, stamina and enhancing sleep quality. What makes cordyceps unusual is that it is actually a combination of fungus and caterpillar, giving it a unique, elongated shape. The primary therapeutic constituents of cordyceps include cordycepin and its derivatives, polysaccharides, and ergosterol. Research continues to demonstrate that these compounds have a vast range of medicinal actions in humans, including [1]:Blood glucose regulationSupporting heart health Enhancing kidney functionStimulating energy (ATP) productionDecreasing fatigue from strenuous exercise Organic Reishi Mushroom (Ganoderma Lucidum) × Close 500 mg Ganoderma lucidum, also known as the reishi mushroom, is a large, robust mushroom that has been used as an immune- and liver-revitalizing agent for centuries in Traditional Chinese Medicine [2]. Reishi mushrooms contain protein and triterpene constituents, specifically ganodermic acids, with potent immunostimulating and hepatoprotective properties [3]. Clinical evidence has shown that ganodermic acids inhibit the release of histamine in mast cells (meaning ganodermic acids modulate pro-inflammatory markers in susceptible body tissues) [4]. The distinct proteins in reishi mushrooms also appear to preserve liver function through antioxidant mechanisms [5]. Organic Lion’s Mane × Close 1,000 mg Lion’s Mane (Hericium erinaceus) is a renowned medicinal mushroom due to its strong bioactive properties, notably bolstering and protecting the nervous system and gastrointestinal (GI) function [6]. Research has shown that Lion’s Mane strongly reduced ulcer area and inhibited ulcer formation in rats treated with ethanol (to induce ulcers) [6]. Lion’s Mane also helps maintain antioxidant status in the mucosa of the GI tract, an important factor for overall gut health and function. Further evidence suggests that Lion’s Mane may have nootropic benefits by promoting the growth and differentiation of neurons in the brain - particularly neurons involved in the cholinergic system [7]. In fact, Lion’s Mane administration increased neurite (dendrites and axons) outgrowth by upwards of 60.6%. 6941.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Prebiotic Greens is a nutritious, fiber-packed, gut-flora friendly greens drink – In each scoop, you’re going to find some of the most mineral dense veggies on earth. Part-One is Algae Greens: Each serving of Prebiotic Greens contains 3 grams of ultra-nutrient rich spirulina and 3 grams chlorella to deliver vitamins, minerals, protein, and heavy-metal detoxification [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. Spirulina and chlorella offer unparalleled nutrition on a gram per gram basis [6, 7, 8, 9]. Part-Two is Prebiotic Fibers: Each serving of prebiotic greens contains 3 grams organic acacia fiber [10, 11], 3 grams organic green banana flour [12, 13], and 1 gram organic Jerusalem artichoke fiber [14, 15, 16] which together provide gut-healthy and gluten free soluble, un-soluble, and slow fermenting fibers [17, 18]. This two pronged approach maximizes nutrient utilization by optimizing your often-overlooked microbiome and consequently affecting all aspects of digestion and wellbeing. Ingredient Profile Organic Spirulina | 3000mg Organic Chlorella | 3000mg Organic Acacia Fibre | 3000mg Green Banana Flour | 3000mg Jerusalem Artichoke Fiber | 1000mg Chicory Root | 1000mg How to Use Mix 1 scoop with 8 ounces of water, juice, or your favorite beverage. Organic Acacia Fibre 3,000 mg Acacia Fibre is a prebiotic fiber from Acacia tree sap that nourishes gut bacteria and promotes digestive health. Green Banana Flour 3,000 mg Green Banana Flour is a prebiotic high in digestion-resistant starch, aiding gut health and blood sugar balance. Jerusalem Artichoke Fiber 1,000 mg Jerusalem artichoke is a root vegetable that is known for its high content of prebiotics including inulin and fructooligosaccharides (FOS). Chicory Root 1,000 mg Chicory root supports a healthy gut microbiome with its natural abundance of inulin. Organic Chlorella × Close 3,000 mg Chlorella (Chlorella vulgaris) is considered a superfood due to its high content of essential nutrients, including vitamins and minerals, protein, and the antioxidant chlorophyll. In fact, Chlorella contains many vitamins, including D, B12, folate, and iron that are either low or absent in most plant foods. [1].Research demonstrates chlorella can positively impact multiple markers of cardiovascular and metabolic health [2,3,4,5] making it a valuable supplement to support longevity and healthy ageing. Spirulina has been extensively studied for its ability to promote healthy cholesterol levels and balance between good and bad cholesterol [11]. [16]Green banana flour has also been noted for its potential weight-management effects. The high fiber and resistant starch content promote satiety, reducing overall caloric intake. 6942.description_text: Overview Have you ever taken a joint supplement for months with little-to-no improvement? It wouldn’t surprise us if that’s the case since most of the joint support formulas on the market provide little more than glucosamine and chondroitin, both of which remain largely unproven in clinical trials. We’ve taken the initiative to create one of the industry’s most comprehensive joint supplements, made exclusively with five of the best clinically-studied ingredients for promoting healthy joint integrity, easing inflammation, and fighting oxidative stress. This innovative joint support formula packs evidence-based doses of patented Curcumin C3 Complex®, FruiteX-B®, Boswellin® Super, UC-II® Collagen, and Bioperine®. By utilizing these standardized and stringently tested ingredients, Transparent Labs Joint Support can help protect, rebuild, and revitalize joints so you can get back to the exercises/activities you love. Ingredient Profile Curcumin C3 Complex | 500mg Calcium Fructoborate | 110mg Boswellin Super | 75mg UC-II | 40mg BioPerine® | 10 mg How to Use As a dietary supplement, take 2 capsules on an empty stomach once or twice a day, or as directed by your physician. FAQs Q.When will my order be shipped out? All orders ship out the following business day. Q. Does Transparent Labs ship to my Country? Transparent Labs ships Worldwide, except to the following countries, unfortunately, due to increasingly high fraudulent activity; Albania, Algeria, India, Lithuania, Macedonia, Romania, Russia, Tunisia, & Ukraine. Q. Does this product contain nuts? We process products in our facility that have nuts (coconuts, peanuts). However, we have an allergen control program in place that sanitizes and cleans our equipment between allergen and non-allergen runs! Q. Is this product vegan? No. WellnessSeries Joint Support is not vegan. Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Curcumin C3® Complex (Curcuma longa) 500 mg Curcumin C3® Complex is a patented herbal extract of Curcuma longa (turmeric) and standardized to contain 95% bioactive curcuminoids. FruiteX-B® 110 mg A patented boron-based mineral (calcium fructoborate) that has been shown to significantly bolster bone mineral density and support joint integrity. Boswellin® Super 75 mg Boswellin® Super is the industry’s most potent extract of Boswellia serrata, containing an abundant profile of acetyl-11-β-boswellic acid (AKBBA) and related triterpenoids. UC-II® Standardized Chicken (Type-II) Collagen 40 mg UC-II® is a clinically tested form of undenatured type-II collagen - the most abundant protein found in joint cartilage. Bioperine® 5 mg This patented extract of black pepper (Piper nigrum) fruit inhibits a specific group of liver enzymes, thereby helping the body readily absorb the other ingredients in TL Joint Support. 6943.description_text: Product Overview Transparent Labs Vitality is an innovative 3-in-1 natural hormone optimizing supplement that boosts bioactive testosterone levels while controlling estrogen and cortisol production. Set the foundation for lean muscle gains, fat burning, strength, libido, confidence, and overall vitality with clinical doses of proven ingredients, such as LJ100® Eurycoma longifolia extract, KSM-66® organic ashwagandha extract, PrimaVie® shilajit extract, L-OptiZinc®, and BioPerine®. These premium ingredients work synergistically to protect Leydig cells that comprise the testicles, reduce aromatase activity, and augment luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) which govern testosterone production and fertility. In turn, TL Vitality primes the body for optimal well-being and athletic performance by encouraging balanced ratios of testosterone to cortisol and testosterone to estradiol. Ingredient Profile Directions: As a Dietary Supplement, Take 2 Capsules Once Daily.Serving Size: 2 CapsulesServings Per Container: 30 Zinc (as L-OptiZinc® (L-Methionine)) - 15 mg L-OptiZinc® is a special chelated zinc that’s formed with L-methionine. Research shows that zinc-methionine complex is one of the most bioavailable forms of zinc, ensuring your body properly absorbs and utilizes this key mineral.1Zinc has diverse actions in the human body since it is a cofactor for various metalloenzymes. Human studies suggest that zinc is especially crucial for supporting fertility and testosterone production in adult males.2,3 One study found that middle-aged men with preexisting infertility experienced an average 250% increase in sperm cell counts and 54% increase in total testosterone levels after taking a zinc supplement daily for three months.4 Also, males with zinc deficiency are generally at a greater risk of infertility.5 Organic Ashwagandha Extract (as KSM-66®) - 600 mg KSM-66® Ashwagandha Root Extract (standardized to contain ≥5% withanolides): Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is arguably the most versatile adaptogenic herb known to man. A thorough body of clinical research has shown that ashwagandha consumption promotes healthy testosterone levels and mitigates stress-induced cortisol secretion, thereby encouraging better quality of life in men.6 Notably, a formative 3-month study of 75 adult males given 600 mg of ashwagandha root extract daily found that testosterone levels increased an average of 40% above baseline values.7 Their sperm cell count (i.e. fertility) also improved significantly. Shilajit Extract (as PrimaVie®) - 250mg Shilajit is a rare exudate (thick fluid) found naturally in rocks of the Himalayan mountains; it’s formed over the course of centuries by microorganisms that decompose plant material. Shilajit is commonly used in Ayurveda as a means of improving vitality and overall well-being. Several controlled human studies have shown that shilajit can significantly increase total testosterone and free testosterone levels, the latter of which is the “biologically useful” form of testosterone.8 One recent clinical trial even found that healthy adult males given a purified shilajit supplement for 90 days experienced nearly 50% greater increases in free testosterone levels than those who were in the placebo group9. Quercetin Dihydrate - 250 mg Quercetin is a secondary plant metabolite (polyphenol) found in a range of fruits and vegetables. It’s a vital micronutrient that serves antioxidant roles in many important body systems, particularly the cardiovascular system and reproductive system.10 Several murine studies suggest that quercetin protects Leydig cells — the cells that comprise testicular tissue — from toxin-induced damage, thereby preserving testosterone levels and fertility11,12. DIM (Diindolylmethane) - 125 mg 3,3′-diindolylmethane (DIM) is a bioactive metabolite of indole-3-carbinol (I3C), a phytochemical found in cruciferous vegetables like cabbage, broccoli, and cauliflower. DIM appears to regulate estrogen metabolism by selectively modulating the aryl-hydrocarbon receptor, which plays an important role in gene expression in both men and women.13 In vivo and in vitro data suggest that DIM has favorable effects on muscle growth, recovery, libido, mood, and overall well-being by balancing estradiol levels14,15 LJ100® (Standardized Eurycoma longifolia extract) - 100mg Eurycoma longifolia, commonly referred to as Tongkat ali or Longjack, has been used for centuries in folk medicine as a natural aphrodisiac and appetite-stimulating herb. The roots of this plant contain a range of compounds called quassinoids, the most noteworthy being eurycomanone. Several studies have shown that athletes supplementing Eurycoma longifolia have significant increases in the ratio of testosterone to cortisol, as well as improvements in lean body mass, strength, and arm circumference.16,17,18 Vitality is formulated with premium LJ100® that delivers a standardized amount of bioactive quassinoids. Bioperine® (Black Pepper (Fruit) Extract) - 10 mg Bioperine® is an extract obtained from the black pepper fruit. In its patented form, BioPerine® has been clinically tested (in the United States) to significantly enhance the bioavailability of various supplement nutrients through increased absorption. Boron (as Bororganic Glycine) - 5 mg Boron is an essential trace mineral that plays numerous roles throughout the body. A recent research review suggests that men who supplement with boron daily have significantly higher levels of testosterone and lower levels of estradiol (estrogen) than those who don’t take a boron supplement.19 Even more compelling, supplemental boron has been shown to boost free testosterone and reduce estrogen within just one week.20 Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Unlike many weight-gainer powders, we prioritize high-quality, natural ingredients to help you gain serious mass while supporting overall health and longevity. Delicious Chocolate and Vanilla Flavors: Choose from two decadent flavors—Chocolate Glaze Donut and Sweet Vanilla. Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body and is essential for skin health, joint support, strong bones, youthful hair and nails, and much more. As we age, our endogenous collagen production begins to decline, contributing to signs of aging, joint pain, bone loss, gastrointestinal deterioration, and impaired muscle function. Supplementing with collagen peptides helps "make up" for the body's lower production levels and improves numerous aspects of our wellbeing and appearance. Key Features Grass-Fed, Pasture-Raised Bovine Collagen Supplement: Grass-fed cows are known to produce byproducts (e.g. milk and collagen) with superior nutritional profiles compared to conventionally raised cattle. The natural grazing diet of grass-fed cows leads to a higher concentration of beneficial nutrients in their collagen, including essential amino acids and bioactive peptides that are vital for the maintenance and repair of body tissues. Support Healthy Hair, Skin Hydration, Joint Integrity, and More: The efficacy of hydrolyzed bovine collagen is supported by numerous studies. For instance, research has demonstrated compelling benefits of daily collagen supplementation for joint health, skin hydration/elasticity, hair quality, muscle recovery, bone turnover, and overall anti-aging. Add to Hot or Cold Liquids: Our collagen powder supplement is easily digested and makes a great addition to your morning coffee or tea for a health and flavor boost. If you prefer cold drinks, simply add it to chilled water, milk, juice, or smoothies to support your wellness goals! Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. Although some proponents claim that collagen protein powder may aid weight loss by promoting satiety and preserving muscle mass, current scientific evidence remains insufficient to support these claims. 6952.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Creatine HMB is an evidence-based step forward for creatine supplementation, which is well-known to enhance muscle growth and athletic performance (e.g. muscle endurance and strength). This formula harnesses the synergy of creatine monohydrate—the most studied form of creatine—and a naturally occurring metabolite known as beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB), the latter of which helps reduce muscle damage and muscle protein breakdown. Creatine HMB is rounded out with BioPerine®, an absorption enhancer, and vitamin D3 for comprehensive muscle recovery. Key Features: 30 Servings Per Container: Each tub of Creatine HMB contains one month's worth of clinically dosed creatine monohydrate, HMB (as MyHMB™), vitamin D3, and BioPerine® to promote athletic performance and increase lean muscle mass. Zero Artificial Additives: Our formula is free from artificial sweeteners, colored dyes, unnecessary fillers, and harmful additives. Instead, we use natural flavors and stevia to satisfy your taste buds without compromising your health. Evidence-Based Synergy: Recent studies (cited below) have shown that creatine monohydrate and HMB significantly improve lean body mass and muscle strength gains beyond creatine or HMB supplementation alone. Versatile Creatine Supplement: Being beneficial for both anaerobic and aerobic performance, Transparent Labs Creatine HMB is suitable for active individuals, gym-goers, and athletes with all types of training goals. Flavors for Everyone: Choose from 13 deliciously refreshing fruit flavors, catering to every palate. Vegan-Friendly Formula: Creatine HMB is crafted with vegan-friendly ingredients to help you perform better, recover quicker, and build/maintain lean muscle mass. Third-Party Tested for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of Transparent Labs Creatine HMB is third-party tested for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits *Doses listed are per serving Creatine Monohydrate | 5,000 mg The performance-enhancing (ergogenic) effects of creatine supplementation are irrefutable and well-established in scientific literature. Supplementation with creatine (monohydrate) works by increasing the amount of creatine within your muscle cells (called "muscle creatine stores"). The additional creatine supply in your muscles serves as a reservoir of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), especially during intense and enduring exercise. Hence, creatine supplementation is consistently shown to improve athletic performance and body composition when combined with resistance training [1]. Notable Studies Referencing the Effects of Creatine: An updated review from the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition suggests that creatine supplementation combined with resistance training significantly improves training adaptations (at a cellular and subcellular level), which may lead to increased strength, accelerated recovery time, and enhanced body composition [2]. Several meta-analyses have confirmed these ergogenic effects of creatine supplementation [3, 4, 5, 6]. In addition, long- and short-term creatine supplementation has been shown to increase muscle mass (and potentially reduce fat mass) in active individuals [7]. β-Hydroxy β-Methylbutyrate (as MyHMB™) | 1,500 mg Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate (HMB), a metabolite of the essential amino acid leucine, has been extensively studied for its potential benefits on muscle mass, strength, and exercise performance, with promising results [8]. When combined with creatine monohydrate, HMB may confer additive effects leading to further improvements in body composition, physical performance, and recovery time [9]. Notable Clinical Studies Referencing the Effects of HMB: A nine-week, randomized, controlled trial of healthy, resistance-trained men found that HMB supplementation had a clear bolstering effect on fat-free mass and substantially strengthened lower-body muscles compared to the placebo group [10]. Another study on college students concluded that HMB supplementation positively affects selected components of aerobic performance (such as muscular endurance) [11]. This study is centered around the effects of HMB supplementation on oxygen capacity for endurance athletes, which found that blood glucose was significantly greater during HMB use and concludes that HMB supplementation may have positive effects on performance [12]. Lastly, a recent meta-analysis demonstrated that older adults may benefit from HMB supplementation as it can help prevent muscle loss due to aging [13]. BioPerine® | 5 mg The black pepper plant (Piper nigrum) is a flowering vine that bears fruits (peppercorns) containing roughly 2-7.4% piperine by mass. In comparison, BioPerine®, a standardized extract of black pepper, contains a minimum 95% piperine by mass. Hence, as little as 5 mg BioPerine® provides as much piperine as 250 mg of most black pepper spices. (For reference, 1/4 teaspoon of ground black pepper weighs about 500 mg.) Piperine, the major alkaloid found in black pepper, has been an emphasis of research in recent years due to its promising bioavailability-enhancing properties [14]. In other words, supplementing with BioPerine® helps increase the amount of active ingredient absorption in Transparent Labs Creatine HMB. Vitamin D3 | 12.5 mcg (500 IU) Vitamin D, often referred to as the "sunshine vitamin," is an essential fat-soluble micronutrient that plays a particularly important role in maintaining healthy bones, nervous system function, and muscle mass. It is synthesized in the skin upon exposure to sunlight and is also found in a variety of foods. 6954.description_text: Overview Curcumin C3® Complex is a clinically studied herbal extract obtained from the dried rhizomes of Cucruma longa (turmeric) and standardized to contain 95% bioactive curcumin, bisdemethoxycurcumin, and demethoxycurcumin — collectively referred to as curcuminoids. Clinical evidence suggests that curcuminoids have ubiquitous roles in the body, affecting vital biological processes such as immune function, detoxification, metabolism, stress response, neuroplasticity, joint integrity, digestion, and much more [1]. When it comes to curcumin supplements and turmeric extract, curcuminoids are generally not well-absorbed orally, resulting in minimal uptake into the bloodstream [2]. This is precisely where our Curcumin C3® Complex capsules shine, as they provide superior absorption and upwards of 200x greater bioavailability than generic curcumin/turmeric extract formulas. 6955.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs Hydrate is a sugar-free electrolyte powder featuring bioavailable minerals, taurine, SenActiv®, and coconut water powder to help you stay hydrated throughout the day and during training. Unlike conventional “sports drinks” and many electrolyte powders, Transparent Labs Hydrate contains no added sugars, artificial coloring, or artificial sweeteners. Instead, this electrolyte supplement is made with natural flavoring and sweetened with stevia to deliver a refreshing, sugar-free hydration boost to your daily water intake. Key Features: Pure Electrolytes for Optimal Hydration: Formulated with a bioavailable electrolyte mixture to promote optimal hydration, including TRAACS® calcium bisglycinate, Aquamin™ magnesium, sodium from Himalayan rock salt, taurine, and natural potassium from organic coconut water powder. Enhanced with Senactiv™: Patented adaptogen complex that supports exercise performance and muscle recovery at the subcellular level. Gluten-Free, Non-GMO, and Naturally Sweetened with Stevia: Sweetened naturally with stevia leaf extract; no added sugar or hidden carbohydrates like other electrolyte supplements. Powdered Drink Mix in Six Refreshing Flavors: Choose from Raspberry Lemonade, Peach Mango, Blue Raspberry, Arctic Freeze, Tropical Punch, and Lemon Lime. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits Senactiv™ | 50 mg: SenActiv® is a patented, clinically studied ergogenic adaptogen complex that provides highly purified and fractionated extracts of Panax notoginseng and Rosa roxburghii (rose hips). The unique phytochemicals in SenActiv® have been shown to enhance subcellular processes that accelerate muscle recovery after exhaustive exercise [1]. These compounds also possess adaptogenic properties to facilitate athletic performance and healthy aging [2]. Taurine | 1,000 mg: Taurine is a naturally occurring sulfonic acid not abundant in the diet. Supplementing with taurine provides cell-hydrating properties and neuroprotective effects throughout the nervous system [3]. In addition, a recent meta-analysis concluded that taurine can significantly enhance stamina, strength, and power capacity during exercise, and it appears to have a range of cognitive benefits as well [4]. Calcium (as TRAACS® Calcium Bisglycinate and Di-Calcium Phosphate) | 84 mg: Calcium is an essential mineral for enhancing the integrity of bone and promoting the growth, proliferation, and differentiation of bone cells [5]. It’s also a crucial micronutrient in muscles as it associates with mitochondria in muscle cells to stimulate ATP synthesis [6]. To ensure optimal efficacy and absorption, TL Hydrate features TRAACS chelated calcium and dicalcium phosphate, two highly bioavailable forms of supplemental calcium [7]. Magnesium (as Aquamin™ Mg) | 50 mg: Extracted from red algae, Aquamin™ is a natural source of magnesium and 72 other trace minerals. Magnesium is a vital electrolyte mineral that has ubiquitous roles in the body, one of which is regulating muscle contraction [8]. Aquamin® Magnesium provides magnesium in its native ionic state for optimal biocompatibility. Magnesium deficiency is well-known to cause issues with the intestines and often contributes to constipation and dehydration [9]. As such, consuming adequate amounts of bioavailable magnesium is imperative for active individuals. Sodium (as Sodium Citrate and from Himalayan Rock Salt) | 500 mg: Sodium is the primary positive ion (cation) in the fluid outside of cells. It modulates the amount of water in the body and the movement of sodium into and out of cells is essential for proper cell-to-cell signaling. Potassium (as Potassium Citrate, Potassium Chloride, and from Organic Coconut Water) | 250 mg: As a counterpart to sodium, potassium is the primary cationic (positively charged) electrolyte inside cells. The balance of sodium and potassium is particularly important for cellular hydration, and potassium is necessary for intra- and inter-cellular signaling, as well as being a substrate for skeletal muscle contraction. Organic Coconut Water Powder | 500 mg: Coconut water powder removes the sugary and fatty constituents of coconut water while retaining the essential electrolyte micronutrients, such as magnesium, potassium, phosphorus, and sodium. Due to its abundant electrolyte profile, coconut water can rapidly rehydrate athletes after intense exercise, making it ideal for pre-, intra-, and post-workout supplementation [11]. How to Use Designed for before, during, and after your workout sessions, Transparent Labs Hydrate rapidly replenishes electrolytes and supports muscle contractility, endurance, recovery, and cell volumization. Get the most out of this electrolyte powder by following these guidelines: Mixing Instructions Mix one scoop of Transparent Labs Hydrate with 6-8 ounces of water. For a consistent mix, use a shaker cup or water bottle and shake until the powder is fully dissolved. If using more than one scoop at a time, adjust the amount of water accordingly; less water will result in a stronger flavor, and vice versa. Optimal Consumption Times Pre-Workout: Drinking our hydration powder before your workout helps prepare your body for physical activity, ensuring you're well-hydrated from the get-go. Intra-Workout: Sipping electrolytes during your workout is especially useful if you start feeling dehydrated and/or you're a heavy sweater. Post-Workout: Taking a serving of Transparent Labs Hydrate after your workout is also great for recovery and rehydration, helping to replenish lost fluids and electrolytes. 6959.description_text: Overview The most crucial time for maximizing muscle growth and results is immediately post-workout as this is when muscle tissue is most sensitive to the anabolic effects of resistance training. Of course, a protein-rich meal or shake is essential after a tough workout, but for optimizing recovery and muscle repair, the body needs targeted “recharging” nutrients that are backed by scientific research and clinical studies. This is precisely why we formulated Transparent Labs Post-Workout with clinical doses of science-based ingredients, including Betapure™, Vitacherry®, Astragin™, Beta-Alanine, L-Glutamine, and L-Carnitine L-Tartrate. These ingredients work synergistically to bolster nitric oxide (NO) production, reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS), facilitate muscle protein synthesis, enhance insulin sensitivity in muscle tissue, and augment gut health so your body is primed for recovery and muscle growth. L-Carnitine L-Tartrate (as Carnipure™) 2,000 mg A bioavailable form of L-carnitine that supports energy metabolism, reduces exercise-induced muscle damage, and aids in muscle recovery. Tart Cherry Powder (as Vitacherry®) 500 mg A concentrated source of polyphenols and anthocyanins that supports recovery by helping manage exercise-induced inflammation and oxidative stress. By sustaining PCr, creatine supports normal muscle contraction and faster recovery between sets—often enabling greater training volume over time. [1] The International Society of Sports Nutrition identifies creatine monohydrate as the most effective supplement for increasing strength and lean mass with resistance training. [2]Consistent use may also support post-exercise glycogen storage and cellular hydration—factors linked to recovery readiness.[3] L-Glutamine (Kyowa® Quality) × Close 5,000 mg Glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in muscle. Heavy training can temporarily lower circulating glutamine—targeted intake supports recovery. Post-exercise ingestion, especially with a carbohydrate, can aid glycogen resynthesis. [4] In endurance, oral L-glutamine helps maintain gastrointestinal barrier integrity and reduces exercise-induced damage markers—supporting recovery and exercise readiness. [5,6]As a key immunonutrient, glutamine fuels lymphocytes and macrophages, supporting normal immune function during heavy training blocks. [7]Kyowa® Quality L-glutamine is produced by microbial fermentation and refined for purity and consistency. L-Carnitine L-Tartrate (as Carnipure™) × Close 2,000 mg Carnipure® is a high-purity form of L-carnitine L-tartrate—a stable compound designed to support efficient energy production and athletic recovery. L-carnitine is an essential molecule that facilitates the transport of long-chain fatty acids into the mitochondria, where they are oxidized for energy.L-carnitine intake has shown benefits for reduced soreness and blood markers of muscle damage (creatine kinase, myoglobin) after lifting or high-intensity work. [8,9]. Consistent L-carnitine supplementation can help optimize the processes of muscle tissue repair and remodeling.[10] Tart Cherry Powder (as Vitacherry®) × Close 500 mg VitaCherry® is a standardized extract of Montmorency tart cherry, formulated to deliver a high concentration of anthocyanins—natural compounds shown to support the body’s response to inflammation and oxidative stress following intense physical activity.Tart cherry supplementation has been shown in multiple studies in athletes and active individuals to reduce muscle damage and enhance muscle recovery after training.
