6960.description_text: Overview Supplementing with the mineral Magnesium is more than just wishful thinking, it’s likely the most underrated supplement in the vitamin and mineral industry. Magnesium isn’t a ‘the more the merrier’ type supplement like protein. Instead, it’s a case of proactively staving off deficiency of this mineral. A deficiency which an estimated 80% of Americans are subject to and don’t even know it. Got a bad diet? Taking magnesium daily should be your strategy. Going through an intense boot camp? Taking magnesium for this period should be your tactic. Ingredient Profile Magnesium Bisglycinate | 300mg How to Use As a dietary supplement, take 3 capsules with or without a meal once or twice a day, or as directed by your physician. FAQs Q. What Magnesium should you take? Well, if you’re familiar with our one-of-a-kind ZMO supplement (Zinc, Magnesium, and Oyster) then you’ll know that not all magnesium supplements are the same! The most common form of magnesium on health store shelves is magnesium oxide, which is in fact, one of the worst types for an athlete to take. This is because oxidized minerals, especially magnesium, have an extremely difficult time entering the body. This ‘difficulty’ paired with magnesium’s muscle-relaxing effects is why magnesium oxide is also often the main ingredient in laxative supplements. Surely, not what you want to take before leg day. Q. What form should you be taking? Magnesium Bisglycinate. We recommend the highly bioavailable and non-laxative Magnesium Bisglycinate. It isn’t cheap like magnesium oxide, but neither are any of the ingredients that we put into any of our products. Got more questions? Magnesium is a fascinating topic that bears influence across every inch of our bodies. We didn’t even begin to cover the common benefits to magnesium supplementation like improved cognition, reduced stress, and muscle relaxation/function. We encourage you to research more! Q. When will my order be shipped out? All orders ship out the following business day. Q. Does Transparent Labs ship to my Country? Transparent Labs ships Worldwide, except to the following countries, unfortunately, due to increasingly high fraudulent activity; Albania, Algeria, India, Lithuania, Macedonia, Romania, Russia, Tunisia, & Ukraine. Q. Does this product contain nuts? We process products in our facility that have nuts (coconuts, peanuts). However, we have an allergen control program in place that sanitizes and cleans our equipment between allergen and non-allergen runs! Q. Is this product vegan? Yes. RawSeries Magnesium Bisglycinate is vegan. Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. Magnesium Bisglycinate Chelate 300 mg Magnesium is a macromineral electrolyte and cofactor (read: "helping hand") in over 350 enzymatic reactions in the human body. Magnesium Bisglycinate Chelate × Close 300 mg One of the most bioavailable forms of magnesium is magnesium bisglycinate—a chelated form of magnesium where the mineral is bonded to glycine, an amino acid. This specific form is noted for its superior absorption and minimal gastrointestinal side effects compared to other forms, such as magnesium oxide [1]. The enhanced absorbability of magnesium bisglycinate can be attributed to glycine acting as a transport molecule, facilitating magnesium passage through the intestinal wall. As a result, a greater proportion of ingested magnesium is absorbed into the bloodstream, thereby increasing overall bioavailability. / Key Ingredients Our formulas are made with clean, natural ingredients, with clinically-validated dosages to support health and performance. As one of the industry’s top-selling pre-workout powders, Transparent Labs Bulk Pre-Workout has separated itself from the competition thanks to a comprehensive, evidence-based lineup of clinically dosed ingredients, fully transparent labeling, and absolutely no artificial color/food dyes, artificial sweeteners, or artificial flavoring. With over 17 grams of active ingredients per scoop, BULK Pre-Workout sets the stage for you to crush it in the gym and pack on lean muscle mass by enhancing muscle strength, blood flow (muscle pumps), endurance, focus, and energy. Key Features Science-Based Pre-Workout Supplement for Increasing Lean Muscle Mass: BULK Pre-Workout is formulated for gym-goers and athletes who prioritize muscle-building and improved physical performance. Enhances Strength, Stamina, and Muscle Pumps During Training: With an unmatched blend of clinically dosed nitric oxide boosters and ergogenic aids, BULK Pre-Workout fortifies athletic performance and bolsters blood flow starting from the very first scoop. Supports Anabolic Hormone Production: The natural testosterone-supporting ingredients in BULK Pre-Workout provide lasting nutritional support for muscle growth and recovery. Promotes Mental acuity, Focus, Drive, and Energy: Get dialed in for every workout with hard-hitting nootropics like AlphaSize® alpha-GPC, PurCaf® caffeine, L-tyrosine, and taurine. Naturally Flavored and Sweetened with Stevia: Most pre-workouts come loaded with artificial colors, sweeteners, or flavors. We know you care about what you put in your body, so BULK Pre-Workout is made with natural flavoring and stevia instead of the hidden junk you find in other pre-workout formulas. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. It's become a popular ingredient in pre-workout supplements due to its ability to boost nitric oxide levels [1]. When nitric oxide production increases, blood flow improves, allowing nutrients and oxygen to replenish muscle tissue more efficiently. Ultimately, this translates to greater muscle pumps and heightened energy levels. Numerous studies have demonstrated the ergogenic effects of L-citrulline malate, the citrulline salt of malic acid, such as: Improving strength, aerobic performance, and muscle endurance [2, 3] Elevating nitric oxide levels even more than equivalent doses of L-arginine [4] Enhancing muscle anabolism and reducing muscle catabolism [5] Beta-Alanine | 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is a beta-amino acid that combines with L-histidine to form a dipeptide known as carnosine. Supplementing with beta-alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine levels, which are quickly depleted during intense exercise [6]. Carnosine is an endogenous dipeptide that functions as a buffer in muscle cells, thereby attenuating the accumulation of acidic byproducts of muscular exertion (e.g. lactate and hydrogen ions) [7]. Hence, bolstering muscle carnosine levels—via beta-alanine—allows you to push yourself longer and harder in the gym. Pre-workout supplements almost always contain beta-alanine but in inefficacious doses. We made sure to include a full clinical dose of beta-alanine (4,000 mg) in every scoop of BULK Pre-Workout. This effect is harmless and gradually lessens with consistent use. 6962.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate has become a pantry staple among health-conscious consumers who want a quality source of protein for supporting muscle growth, recovery, and overall health. Unlike many protein powders on the market, TL whey protein isolate is sourced from grass-fed cattle, raised humanely and without the use of growth hormones or hormonal agents, and contains absolutely no artificial sweeteners, food dyes, or fillers. Choose from 14 (and counting) delicious flavor options, or select the unflavored option if you prefer a pure whey protein isolate powder with a neutral taste. Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate is easy to mix with liquids and can be incorporated into various recipes, making it a convenient and versatile protein source that fits easily into any diet. Key Features: 28 grams of protein per serving, boasting an industry-leading protein-by-weight percentage of 87.5% (may vary slightly by flavor). Sourced exclusively from grass-fed American dairy cattle, raised without the use of growth hormone, growth factors, and/or anabolic steroids. Made with natural ingredients and no artificial sweeteners, fillers, food dyes, gluten, or preservatives. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice and Informed Protein to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Virtually lactose-free and only 1 gram of fat per serving, perfect for adding an easily digestible, quality source of protein to your diet. Trusted by the best to be the best, with an overall rating of 98 out of 100 by Labdoor and backed by athletes like Paul Sklar & Hafthor Björnsson, Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate has set a standard as the cleanest whey protein powder available. Available in 14 delicious flavors that cater to every palate while supporting lean muscle growth and overall protein intake. Active Ingredients and Benefits Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate The quality of your protein matters, and whey protein isolate is one of the purest forms of protein available. It provides a high protein content with minimal fats and carbohydrates, making it an exceptional choice for building muscle and accelerating recovery between workouts. In contrast to whey protein concentrate, whey protein isolate undergoes further filtration to remove virtually all of the lactose, making it more suitable for those who have difficulty digesting lactose. Whey protein isolate is known for its rapid absorption and ideal ratio of all nine essential amino acids (EAAs)—which includes the branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs)—necessary for stimulating muscle protein synthesis [1, 2]. In other words, whey protein isolate is about as good as it gets for kickstarting the muscle-building process after working out. By providing essential nutrients needed for muscle repair, whey protein isolate can reduce recovery time, allowing for more consistent and intense training sessions. So, why does the "grass-fed" distinction matter for whey protein powder? The vast majority of whey protein powders are made from the milk of grain-fed cows, whereas grass-fed whey protein is derived from the milk of cows that graze on natural, pesticide-free grass pastures instead of feeding on grains. Grass-feeding positively impacts the nutritional composition and quality of a cow's milk (which is subsequently used to make cheese, and "whey" is a byproduct of cheesemaking) [3]. Research has found that grass-fed whey protein boasts higher levels of bioactive whey peptides (e.g. immunoglobulins and lactoferrin), omega-3 essential fatty acids, conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), and vitamins E and A—nutrients essential for inflammation control, muscle recovery, and overall health [4]. Just as important, grass-fed whey protein isolate is free from added hormones and antibiotics that may persist in conventional dairy products [5]. How to Use Maximize your results with Transparent Labs Whey Protein Isolate by following these guidelines: Mixing Instructions Combine one scoop (~32 g) of Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Protein Isolate with 6-8 ounces of water, milk, or your preferred beverage in a shaker cup (with a wire whisk ball) for a smooth, delicious protein shake. Seal the shaker cup and shake vigorously for a few seconds until the powder is fully dissolved, then enjoy! Optimal Consumption Times Post-Workout Recovery: Whey protein isolate is quickly absorbed by the body, making it ideal for post-workout recovery as it helps to repair and build muscle tissue efficiently. Anytime Protein Boost: Our grass-fed whey protein isolate can also be used in recipes (e.g., pancakes) and incorporated into foods like yogurt and oatmeal to easily increase daily protein intake. FAQs How Does Whey Protein Isolate Differ from Whey Protein Concentrate? Whey Protein Isolate undergoes additional processing to remove most of the lactose and fat content, leaving >90% protein. Whey protein isolate is often preferred over whey protein concentrate due to its higher protein purity and reduced allergen content. Is Whey Protein Good for Weight Loss or just Muscle Building? Protein is known for its satiating and thermodynamic effects, which can help reduce hunger and increase calorie expenditure. Incorporating whey protein isolate into your diet can assist in weight management by promoting fullness and an energy deficit. What’s in your “Natural Flavors”? The natural flavors used in our products are derived from natural sources such as plants, fruits, or spices to enhance the taste of our products. 6963.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs STIM-FREE Pre-Workout is for gym-goers and active individuals who exercise later in the afternoon/evening and those who are sensitive to stimulants like caffeine. Alternatively, you might be taking a "stim break" and looking to cut back on caffeine. In either case, this non-stimulant pre-workout formula has you covered with an evidence-based lineup of clinically dosed ingredients, coming in at a whopping 17 grams per serving! Combine that with fully transparent labeling, great flavor, and absolutely no artificial color/food dyes, artificial sweeteners, or artificial flavoring, and it's no wonder STIM-FREE Pre-Workout has become a fan favorite. Key Features Stimulant-Free Pre-Workout Formula Backed by Science: Ideal for those sensitive to caffeine and nighttime gym-goers, Transparent Labs STIM-FREE Pre-Workout is formulated with clinically effective dosages of ergogenic ingredients to enhance your athletic performance without stimulants. Enhances Strength, Stamina, and Muscle Pumps: With an unmatched blend of clinically dosed nitric oxide boosters, STIM-FREE Pre-Workout bolsters muscle strength, endurance, and blood flow starting from the very first scoop. Promotes Clean, Lasting Focus, Drive, and Energy: Get dialed in for every workout with evidence-based nootropics like taurine, L-tyrosine, and huperzine-A. Since this is a stimulant-free formula, it won't give you jitters or cause a post-workout crash. Naturally Flavored and Sweetened with Stevia: Most non-stim pre-workouts are loaded with artificial colors, sweeteners, and flavors. We know you care about what you put in your body, so STIM-FREE Pre-Workout contains only natural flavoring and stevia instead of the hidden junk you find in other pre-workout supplements. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. Active Ingredients and Benefits L-Citrulline Malate (2:1) |8,000 mg L-citrulline is an amino acid naturally found in watermelon that plays an important role in kidney function. It's become a popular ingredient in pre-workout supplements due to its ability to boost nitric oxide levels [1]. When nitric oxide production increases, blood flow improves, allowing nutrients and oxygen to replenish muscle tissue more efficiently. Ultimately, this translates to greater muscle pumps and heightened energy levels. Numerous studies have demonstrated the ergogenic effects of L-citrulline malate, the citrulline salt of malic acid, such as: Improving strength, aerobic performance, and muscle endurance [2, 3] Elevating nitric oxide levels even more than equivalent doses of L-arginine [4] Enhancing muscle anabolism and reducing muscle catabolism [5] Beta-Alanine | 4,000 mg Beta-alanine is a beta-amino acid that combines with L-histidine to form a dipeptide known as carnosine. Supplementing with beta-alanine has been shown to increase muscle carnosine levels, which are quickly depleted during intense exercise [6]. Carnosine is an endogenous dipeptide that functions as a buffer in muscle cells, thereby attenuating the accumulation of acidic byproducts of muscular exertion (e.g. lactate and hydrogen ions) [7]. Hence, bolstering muscle carnosine levels—via beta-alanine—allows you to push yourself longer and harder in the gym. Pre-workout supplements almost always contain beta-alanine but in inefficacious doses. We made sure to include an evidence-based dose of beta-alanine (2,000 mg) in every scoop of LEAN Pre-Workout. Relevant evidence-based benefits of beta-alanine include: Delaying the onset of neuromuscular fatigue during intense exercise [8] Increasing overall muscle strength [9] Improving muscle endurance and total work capacity [10] Reducing and combatting the formation of dysfunctional proteins and promoting the formation of healthy proteins [11] Significantly increasing lean muscle mass as part of a diligent resistance-training program [12] *Note that beta-alanine causes a benign tingling sensation known as paresthesia while the body acclimates to higher carnosine levels. This effect is harmless and gradually lessens with consistent use. BetaPure™ Betaine Anhydrous | 2,500 mg Betaine, also known as trimethylglycine, is a biologically important osmolyte and methyl donor. Betaine supplementation has been shown to improve strength gains and, to a lesser extent, endurance capacity in athletes [13, 14, 15]. Though the mechanisms are not entirely clear, Pre-workout betaine use ostensibly promotes athletic performance by maintaining cellular hydration and reducing homocysteine levels, thereby supporting cardiovascular health [16]. Taurine | 1,300 mg L-taurine is a non-proteinogenic amino acid often considered essential to pre-workout supplementation due to its diverse benefits for athletes and gym-goers. For one, taurine is a potent nootropic that promotes focus and attenuates brain cell inflammation and oxidative stress [17, 18]. Taurine can also enhance physical performance via increased blood flow to skeletal muscle tissue [19, 20]. Greater blood flow to muscle tissue encourages a favorable milieu for muscle function and recovery during training. Additionally, taurine supplementation has been shown to improve performance in endurance athletes [21]. L-Tyrosine | 1,000 mg L-tyrosine is a conditionally essential amino acid and precursor to dopamine and norepinephrine, two neurotransmitters that govern motivation and reward. Research shows that supplementing with L-tyrosine can significantly enhance cognitive performance and increase alertness, especially under acute stress (such as intense training) [22]. 6964.description_text: Overview Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine is the all-natural solution for active individuals and athletes looking to accelerate muscle recovery, reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS), and support hydration. Each serving of this deliciously refreshing formula provides 8,000 mg of fermented, vegan-friendly branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) in the evidence-based 2:1:1 ratio, plus 5,000 mg of L-glutamine, 1,500 mg of vitamin C, and 1,000 mg of coconut water powder. Unlike many BCAA supplements, our BCAA powder doesn't contain animal-derived amino acids, added sugars, artificial sweeteners (e.g., acesulfame potassium and sucralose), artificial food dyes, or unnecessary additives. Key Features Clinically Dosed BCAA Powder: Each serving of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine includes 8,000 mg of vegan branched-chain amino acids in a 2:1:1 ratio to enhance muscle recovery, reduce muscle soreness, and bolster muscle protein synthesis. Synergistic Formula for Pre-/Intra-/Post-Workout Use: In addition to branched-chain amino acids, our BCAA powder provides 5,000 mg of L-glutamine, 1,500 mg of vitamin C, and 1,000 mg of coconut water powder to promote hydration, support immune function, and decrease muscle damage. Vegan-Friendly, Gluten-Free, and Non-GMO: Many BCAA supplements contain low-grade amino acids derived from human hair; we formulated an original BCAA powder with fermented, vegan-friendly BCAAs made from microbial cultures. This product is also non-GMO and gluten-free to accommodate your healthy lifestyle. Pure, Quality Ingredients (No Fillers or Nonsense): Consistent with our core values, Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine is third-party tested for purity, potency, and authenticity. Our BCAA powder is naturally flavored and sweetened with stevia to accommodate your healthy lifestyle; no artificial additives or sugar. Delicious and Natural Fruit Flavors: Choose from four tasty flavors - Strawberry Lemonade, Blue Raspberry, Sour Green Apple, and Tropical Punch. Third-Party Tested and Certified for Quality: As part of our commitment to industry-leading transparency and quality, every batch of this product is tested by a third-party lab for purity and potency. You can find all of our test results in the footer of our website. This product is also certified by Informed Choice to meet the highest standards for athletes and consumers. How to Use Instructions Combine one (1) level scoop of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine with 10-12 ounces of cold water or your preferred beverage and mix until powder is fully dissolved. Consume 30-45 minutes before, during, or immediately after your workout. An additional one to two scoops may be taken throughout the day. Do not exceed three (3) servings per day. Optimal Consumption Times Pre-Workout: Consuming our BCAA powder before your workout helps prime your body for exercise with key amino acids and micronutrients. Intra-Workout: Sipping on a serving of Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine during your workout can prevent a decline in performance by mitigating muscle fatigue and sustaining hydration. This is especially beneficial if you tend to sweat a lot or exercise in hot/humid conditions. Post-Workout: Ingesting Transparent Labs BCAA Glutamine post-workout aids in recovery by supporting protein synthesis, reducing soreness, and rehydrating the body. Active Ingredients and Benefits Fermented Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs) 2:1:1 | 8,000 mg Branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) are a group of three essential amino acids—L-leucine, L-isoleucine, and L-valine—that play an integral role in muscle protein synthesis, the process by which cells create new muscle proteins (which is necessary for muscle recovery and hypertrophy). While there are nine essential amino acids, L-leucine is widely regarded as the “master regulator” of protein synthesis [1]. Research suggests that supplementing with a 2:1:1 ratio of BCAAs (leucine: isoleucine:valine) post-workout can mitigate the severity of delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) and decrease muscle damage markers, such as creatine kinase [2]. Further evidence indicates that BCAA supplementation improves endurance and muscle strength by reducing rates of perceived exertion and increasing lactate thresholds during exercise [3, 4]. Additionally, BCAAs can help protect against muscle protein breakdown during weight-loss phases [5, 6]. Glutamine | 5,000 mg L-glutamine is the most abundant free amino acid in human muscle and plasma; however, it is a conditionally essential amino acid for active gym-goers and athletes since intense and long-duration exercise can deplete glutamine stores in the body [7]. Studies show that glutamine supplementation helps improve muscle glycogen synthesis, gut health, and immune function in active individuals, making it useful for muscle recovery and performance [8, 9, 10]. Clinical research has shown that glutamine also plays a key role in protein synthesis despite being a non-essential amino acid [11]. Vitamin C | 1,500 mg Vitamin C is a ubiquitous antioxidant vitamin that, when taken in large doses (>1 gram per day), can reduce muscle soreness and bolster recovery between workouts [12]. It also plays a vital role in collagen synthesis and throughout the immune system, with evidence that it may reduce the severity and duration of upper respiratory tract infections [13]. Coconut Water Powder | 1,000 mg Coconut water is one of the best natural sources of electrolytes and trace minerals, making it a perfect ingredient for replenishing and rehydrating during and after training. Coconut (Cocos nucifera) has been shown to provide a wealth of general health benefits, including, but not limited to [14]: Rehydrating the body Fighting inflammation Balancing blood glucose and insulin levels Promoting immune function Enhancing eye and skin health Supporting kidney function FAQs Section What Does BCAA Powder Do?
